tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sngags 'chang rnams la med thabs med pa'i dus rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi'i ril bu bsgrub tshul gyi gsung rab rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa nyon mongs nad kun sel ba'i sman mchog bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ rje btsun rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /gus pas btud de gsang sngags 'dzin rnams kyis/ /rgyun du za ba'i rdzas mchog bsgrub pa'i tshul/ /gong ma'i gsung rnams btus te 'dir spel lo/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas/ 'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sngags 'chang rnams la med thabs med pa'i dus rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub tshul gyi gsung rab rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa nyon mongs nad kun sel ba'i sman mchog bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la don bdun te/ rje btsun mchog gi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ de lta bu'i bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rdzas kyi ril bu 'di la byin rlabs kyi rgyun bzhugs tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'khrul pa'i dri ma thams cad zad par spangs pa rje btsun rin po che dpal ldan grags pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras glegs bam gyi nang na bzhugs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub tshul gyi gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig ni/

rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ na dang ga ha dang po dang / /mtha' yi sha dang dang po'i sha /kyai rdo rje las gsungs pa'i/ /bdud rtsi lnga'ang de bzhin bza'/ /zhes pa la brten nas dam tshig gi rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa bstan pa ni/ sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ thog mar rdzas dang yo byad rnams bsog par bya ste/ de'ang tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad ci tsam 'byor pa bsog gzhan yang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa bsog ste/ sha lnga ni/ mi'i sha dang / ba lang gi sha dang / khyi'i sha dang / rta'i sha dang / glang po che'i sha dang lnga'o/ /de la glang po che'i sha ma rnyed na mi'i shas dod byas pas chog gsungs/ bdud rtsi lnga ni/ dri chu dang / dri chen dang / rak+ta dang / byang chub kyi sems dang / sha chen zer yang mi'i klad pa yin gsungs so/ /de ltar lnga'o/ /gzhan yang de rnams kyi brda bsog par bya ste/ dri chu'i brda gla rtsi/ dri chen gyi brda a ru ra/ rak+ta'i brda du ru ka byang sems kyi brda ga pur/ sha chen gyi brda tsan+dan dmar po/ gzhan yang 'bras bu gsum dang / tsha ba gsum la sogs pa ci rigs par bsog go /de nas bsgrub pa'i grogs dam tshig thob la ma nyams pa mang na bdun brgyad/ nyung na gsum mam bzhi'i bar gral byas la bzhag go /de nas gnas khang phyag dar bya ba dang / bla bre bre ba dang / bris sku la sogs pa bkram la/ grub na dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ ma grub na bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal byas pas chog mchod pa bsham pa dang / gtor ma la sogs pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i thun mtshams kyi bya ba las byung ba'i yi ge bzhin bya'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga dang / brda lnga dang / 'bras bu gsum la sogs pa rnams dang / bla ma brgyud pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu'i gta' ma dang bcas pa phye mar btags la dri chus sbyar la lde gu byas te/ sha lnga po la bskus la de rnams ka pā la'i snod gcig gam lngar so sor bzhag go /de yang dbus su mi'i sha

shar du ba lang gi sha lhor khyi'i sha nub tu rta'i sha byang du glang po che'i sha'o/ /de nas zangs ma'i shog bu la srung ba'i 'khor lo bris pa'i steng du dgab ste srung skud kyis bcings la bzhag go /de nas bsgrub pa'i tshad ni zhag bdun bsgrub par bya ste/ zhag gsum gong bu/ zhag gsum lde gu/ zhag gcig ril bu'i bsgrub pa'o/ /dus ni nyi shu gsum nas dgu'i bar du'o/ /de'ang 'byor pa'i bye brag gis zhag re re la rab kyis tshogs drug 'bring gis bzhi/ tha mas gnyis/ de'ang ma 'byor na re re bya'o/ /bsgrub pa'i cho ga la nam 'jug pa'i dus su/ bla ma la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la rang rang gi gral la 'dug pa dang / las kyi slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa dang / yi ge brgya pa 'don pa nas bdag gi rnal 'byor dang bzlas pa byed pa'i bar du tshogs kyi cho ga nar ma bzhin byas la/ de nas thams cad kyis bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs te/ ting nge 'dzin ni nang gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa dang khyad par med la/ bye brag tu spyi'i dmigs pa ni/ 'dir steng gi oṃ dang nyi ma dang / rdo rje dang gsum mi btung bar de rnams la bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag par bsam zhing 'bru gsum bzla/ so so'i ni mi mang po yod na gsum gyis re mos gzungs thag nas bzung nas gsung ma chag par bzla/ nyung na gnyis sam ci rigs par nus tshad du bzla 'o/ /gsum gsum gyi re mos gzungs thag nas bzung nas sum+bha ni'i sngags gsung ma chag tu bzla/ nyung na ci rigs par bzlas so/ /thun spo ba'i tshe rang rang gi yan lag drug pa'i mngon rtogs tshang bar bsgom zhing / bdud rtsi byin rlabs gsal gdab cing bya/ snga mas bzlas pa 'jog khar oṃ dang nyi ma rdo rje gsum zhu bar bsam/ de bzhin du thun nam mtshams spod pa'i tshe snga mas zhu bar bsam/ phyi mas gsal gdab cing bsgom gsungs/ de nas nub gsum song ba dang rdzas de rnams stan pa'i khud du zhib par btags la lde gu dgong mo ci rigs par bgos la sngar bzhin yang thod par blugs la phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar bzhag la sgrub pa bya'o/

/de nas yang nub gsum song ba'i nyin bar de rnams ril bu byas te/ che chung gi tshad che na sran ma tsam/ chung na nyung 'bru tsam bya/ de nas yang thod par blugs la rang sar bzhag la sgrub pa bya'o/ /de nas grogs spyi'i dmigs pa ni/ sgrub pa thon pa dang / steng gi nyi ma dang rdo rje rnams thod par lhung nas bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam pa'am/ thun re la bskyed cing byin rlabs zhu bar bsam pa gang rung bya zhing thams cad kyis 'bru gsum bzla 'o/ /de nas bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir thams cad kyis sum+bha ni'am/ rtsa sngags la sogs pa ci rigs par bzla 'o/ /de nas de rnams bsdus la bla mas gsum 'gyur ram lnga 'gyur du tshags byas/ gzhan sgrub g.yog byed pa rnams la skal ba sbyin/ yo byad sbyor ba'i yon bdag yod na yang skal ba mang du sbyin/ gzhan slong ba rnams la yang ci rigs par sbyin no/ /de nas de rnams so so rang rang gi za ma tog la sogs pa snod bzang por bzhag la/ rab kyis thun bzhir thog mtha' re re brgyad/ yang na re re ste nges par bzhi bsten/ 'bring gis thun gnyis la re re bsten/ tha mas kyang thun dang po la re re bsten/ de ma 'grub na zla ba re la re re bsten/ de'ang ma grub na zla ba drug la re re bsten/ de'ang ma grub na lo re'i dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig gam bco lnga la re re bsten gsungs/ de ltar byas pas bar chad zhi ba dang dngos grub thams cad myur du 'grub pa yin gsungs so/ /bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i rim pa bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas gsungs pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan la gcung gis gsol ba btab nas bris pa'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis lugs 'di'i yig cha thams cad kyi rten gzhi'am/ rtsa ba lta bur gyur pa rje btsun mchog gi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/

gsung ngag rin po che glegs bam rje btsun rin po ches lhan cig tu bsgrigs nas dkar chag mdzad par/ man ngag phra mo gzhan gyi dkar chag bri bar ma nus so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag phra mo'i skor rnams rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po yab sras rnams kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrig par mdzad pa'i lam 'bras po ti dmar bsdus su grags par bzhugs pa'i chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub tshul gyi yi ge bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos gzhi lnga dang / brda lnga dang / kha ba tshe ba rdo rje dbul ba dang / a ka ru nag kyai rdo rje la sogs pa phyogs su bkod nas bgegs sdig pa dri ma rnams sbyangs nas/ swa bha was stong par bsam pa'i ngang las so so'i sa bon las so so bskyed nas/ so so'i rigs dang mthun pa'i ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ gzugs sbyong zhing sku'i dngos grub ster ba'i ngo bor gyur te/ oṃ āḥgho hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā la sogs pa brjod de/ na dang ga dang dang po dang / /dang po'i sha dang gang gi mthar/ /sha lnga rnal 'byor pa yis bza'/ /'di dag sha lnga'i mchog yin te/ /rgyal ba yab lnga'i ngo bo nyid/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho 'gugs byed pa'i/ /lcags kyu rnam pa lnga yang yin/ /rigs dang dngos grub gsal ba yi/ /sgron ma lnga yang 'di yin no/ /oṃ āḥmahā pañca mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes brjod do/ /de bzhin du sa bon las rnam par snang mdzad gti mug sbyong zhing me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du dmigs la/ oṃ āḥbi hūm̐ phaṭ la sogs pa brjod nas mi bskyod brten pa'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa 'di/ 'di lnga bdud rtsi'i mchog yin te/ /rgyal ba yum lnga'i ngo bo nyid/ /'chi med tshe dang mchog stsol ba/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga yin no/ /oṃ āḥmahā pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/

de nas rdzas gzhan gyi de nyid gsum las bskyed pa las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi tshogs la thim par bsam zhing / de nyid gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ gong bu byin gyis brlabs pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ /rdo rje pad+ma rang bzhin gyis/ /stan dang gtun gyis rab sbyangs pa/ /snod gcig blugs nas ji bzhin du/ /bskyed nas sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ /khyad par yang ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ āḥgo go ru mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥku ku ru mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥd da dha mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥha hasti mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥn na ra mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbi ta a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥr ka ta a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥshu kra a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥmasti ka a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥmu tra a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ sa bon so so'i ye shes kyang / /so sor bskyed cing byin rlabs nas/ /oṃ āḥbrum̐ ā dar+ṣa dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥs ma ta dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥdz+riṃ prad+ya bak+ṣe dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥkham̐ kri t+ya a nuṣ+tha na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dharmā dhā tu dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ rnams so/ /phye ma byin gyis brlabs pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /myos byed tsha ba nying khu ru/ /byas pa la sogs lde gur bya/ /yongs su rdzogs par bskyed nas ni/ /sngar bzhin byin gyis brlab par bya/ /lde gu byin gyis brlabs pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /de nas ril bur byas la/ sngar bzhin bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ gyis byin gyis brlabs pa yis/ /kha dog phun sum tshogs gyur cing / /sku yi rdo rje spyan drangs nas/ /rnal 'byor lus kyi dngos grub 'gyur/ /āḥyis byin gyis brlabs pa yis/

/phun sum tshogs pa'i ro ldan zhing / /gsung gi rdo rje spyan drangs nas/ /rnal 'byor ngag gi dngos grub 'gyur/ /hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa yis/ /nus pa phun sum tshogs gyur cing / /thugs kyi rdo rje spyan drangs nas/ /rnal 'byor sems kyi dngos grub 'gyur/ /ha yis kha dog 'phrog par byed/ /'phrogs nas 'phags pa mchod byed cing / /sems can thams cad tshim byed pa'i/ /kha dog dam par byin gyis brlabs/ /ha ha ha/ hos ni dri ni 'jig par byed/ /bshigs nas 'phags pa mchod byed cing / /sems can thams cad tshim byed pa'i/ /dri mchog ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /hoḥhoḥhoḥhoḥhrīḥni nus pa 'jig par byed/ /bshig nas 'phags pa mchod byed cing / /sems can thams cad tshim byed pa'i/ /nus mchog ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥhrīḥde nas tshe bsgrub pa'i phyir tshe dpag med yab yum gyi 'dus sbyor las byung ba'i bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing / sngags so so'i mthar/ a yu puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ dang / oṃ puṇ+ya'i bzlas pa mang du bya'o/ /thog mar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ /rdzogs nas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya/ /phud kyis mchod nas slar yang ni/ /zhi bas lhag chad nyes pa sbyangs/ /bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba 'phags pas sbyar ba'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa bdag chen chos kyi rje blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gzhan gyis mtshungs pa med pa'i bdag nyid chen po bdag chen chos kyi rje de nyid kyi gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ khyab bdag rgyal ba lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /sku lnga'i bdag nyid dam pa la/ /yan lag lnga yi gus btud nas/ /ma dag sbyang gzhi lcags kyi khams/

/dag pa'i gser du sgyur byed pa/ /gser 'gyur rtsi lta'i thabs kyi mchog /bsgrub pa'i cho ga yang dag bshad/ /yo byad bsag cing bkod pa dang / /dngos gzhi ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul/ /bsten pa'i thabs dang phan yon te/ /rnam pa bzhi yis rab tu bsdus/ /de la 'dir/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa dang po'i bcu gcig pa las/ na na dang por yod pas na ra mi'i sha dang ga ga dang por yod pa ga wi ba lang gi sha ha ha dang por yod pa hasti glang po che'i sha dang po dang / /mtha' yi sha na mtha' mar yod pa a shwa rta'i sha dang dang po'i sha / sha dang por yod pa shwa na khyi'i sha ste lnga/ kyai rdo rje'i dngos grub phyir/ /bdud rtsi lnga yang de dri chen/ dri chu/ byang sems dkar dmar/ sha chen dwangs ma ste/ bzhin bza'/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dus rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i tshul la/ mtshan nyid pa dang / rjes mthun pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rlung sems la dbang 'byor cing / brtan pa cher thob pa'i gang zag gis/ bdag dang rtogs pa mnyam pa lung bstan pa'i rnal 'byor ma dang / lhan cig tu ji lta bar bsgrubs nas/ dngos grub kyi phyir kha zas kyi tshul du bsten pa ste/ 'di ni kyai rdo rje'i rgyud phyi ma phyag chen thig le'i le'u bcu gnyis pa las 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o/ /'dir da ltar gyi rdo rje slob dpon dam tshig dang sdom par ldan zhing / bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa/ bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa ci rigs pa thob pa'am/ dngos sam rmi lam du yi dam gyi lhas rjes su 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma brnyes pa'i gang zag gis/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don du rjes mthun pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa'i cho ga bstan pa la/ rdzas dang yo byad bsag cing bkod pa/ dngos gzhi ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul/ de nyid bsten pa'i thabs/ de ltar bsten pa'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po la'ang rdzas bsag pa dang /

ji ltar bkod pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po rdzas kyi gtso bo sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga mngon par 'du bya ste/ de'ang mi'i sha ni/ mtshams med lnga byas pa dang / mi bsad pa'i sha la dngos grub mi 'byung / chos grogs sam bla ma'i sku sha lta bu ni/ rang sha yin pas de dag la mtshon 'debs pa dang / stan bla chen 'brog gi dngos slob 'brom de pa ston chung gis mdzad pa'i gsang chu'i yi ger/ par brdung pa sogs spong bar bshad pas de ma yin pa'i sha chen te/ rab skye ba bdun pa'i sha bsten tshul bde mchog las 'byung zhing / ma rnyed na sngar mtshams med lnga ma byas shing / mi ma bsad pa'i skyes pa dar ma/ tshes brgyad/ bcu bzhi/ nyi shu lnga rnams la g.yul du bsad pa'i sha'o/ / dgos te/ phyag chen thig ler/ brgyad dang yang na bcu bzhi dang / /yang na bcu ni mar gyi ngor/ /mdung rtse yang ni ral gris bsad/ /rigs lnga'i nang na rigs gcig go /na tsha med dang bde ba 'grub/ /brgya dang lang tsho ldan pa dang / /skye ba bdun nam yang na gsum/ /zhes so/ /ba glang gi sha ni yun ring nad kyis gdungs pa lta bu nus pa chung bas mi rung la/ de ma yin pa'i ba glang gi sha gang rnyed pas btub cing / glang po ni glang chen gyi sha dngos rnyed na rab/ de ma rnyed na mi'i shas dod bya rje btsun gyis/ ba'am/ yang na 'brom gyis gsang chu'i yi ger/ bod du glang dkar spos lo bza' ba des chog ste/ glang chen dang ming dang zas dang mdog gcig pas so/ /rta dang khyi'i sha ni nad ngan pas shi ba ma yin pa/ mdog dkar can shis par gsungs pas/ 'brom gyis bshad cing / phyag chen thig le'i rgyud du'ang / dkar po'i sha dkar dang ldan pas/ /zhes so/ /de dag bdud rtsi lnga ni 'gal rkyen spangs shing / mthun rkyen yon tan dang ldan pa las blang ste/ de'ang dam tshig nyams pa dang / rngul 'thon pa dang / thig le nyams pa dang / ngal zhing dub pa ma yin pa/

rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor thun bzhir bsgom pa'i yon tan can gyis rnal 'byor pho mo las byung ba'i dri chen/ dri chu/ khu ba/ rak+ta rnams dang / sha chen gyi dwangs ma ste mi'i klad pa rnams blangs la/ de lta bu'i bdud rtsi lnga po de rnams kyang rdo phyag thig tu/ a ka ru sogs kyis bdug go /rdo yi snod du bzhag par bya/ /zhes so/ /g.yam la sogs pa'i snod gtsang mar ma rul/ ma sum par grib skam legs par bya/ sum+bha nis bgegs bskrad cing dus bzhir srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la mchod gtor ci 'byor du phul la byin gyis rlobs par gsol ba btab/ gzhan yang de rnams dang 'brel ba'i brda lnga'ang bsog par bya ste/ dri chu'i brda gla rtsi/ dri chen gyi brda a ru ra/ gser mdog tsan+dan dmar po 'dra ba la/ rak+ta'i brda du ru ka da bas shing zhib cing dri zhim pa zhig 'byung / byang sems brda ga pur/ sha chen gyi brda tsan+dan dmar po/ gzhan yang kha ba/ tsha ba la sogs pa'i sman gyi bye brag rnams dang / a ka ru dang / tsan+dan la sogs pa'i dri dang / spos kyi bye brag ci 'byor du bsog ste/ mdor na 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par bya'o/ /gnyis pa de ltar bkod pa'i tshul la/ rje btsun rin po ches/ dus nyi shu gsum nas nyer dgu'i bar du bsgrub par gsungs pa ni rnal 'byor pa mchog gis de la 'grub pa'i dbang du mdzad kyis/ las dang po pas thad gong bu phye ma sogs/ ka'i ltas dang bstun pa las de bzhin gyi nges pa med pas/ tshes grangs gang yang rung ba'i gza' skar bzang ba la brtsams te/ de'ang dkyil 'khor dang 'brel par byed na spyod pa bdun nam brgyad dang ldan pa'i rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas nub gnyis pa lta bu la bya/ maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba byed na/ gnas khang de nyid kyi dbus sam ji ltar rigs par bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor dang bcas pa phyag len bzhin du bshams/

gang ltar yang dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su sa stegs dpangs su mtho gang / rgya'i tshad thod pa lngar bsgrubs na ngos rer khru do gru bzhi dang / gcig las med na khru gang gru bzhi pa lta bu 'jam zhing star bar bya/ ba byung lnga dang tshon dkar po bsregs pas byugs te kha dog bsgyur/ de nas cho ga tshang bar bya ba'i phyir/ ro skra'am bdag med rtogs pa dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin gyis brlab phyir/ rkun ma'i skra la bcos pa'i thig skud kyi tshangs zur yongs su rdzogs par gdab/ dbus na sor nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i tshad kyi zlum bskor dang / de'i phyir mu khyud/ ji ltar 'tshams pas bskor/ nang du le dgu'i thig gdab la/ dbus sngo/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / phyogs bzhi dbus dang bcas pa'i le tshe lngar pad+ma 'dab bzhi mdzes tshon du dgod/ thod pa gcig las med na le dgu sogs mi dgos/ dbus su snod dang 'tshams pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa bya/ tshon rnams chu tshon du byas na brtan cing mi 'jig pas legs so/ /de ltar bri ba rdzogs pa dang gu gul gyis bdug bgegs bskrad/ rin po che las grub pa'i sa gzhi dang pho brang du bsam mo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor der rdzas dgod par bya ste/ snod kyi bye brag skye bdun gyi thod pa'am/ gzhan dum bu gcig pa sogs thod pa mtshan ldan dngos rnyed na rab/ min na rin po che dang rdza las byas pa sogs kyis rung bar sdom 'byung gi rgyud las gsungs shing / 'phags pa rin po ches ril bu bsgrub par mdzad dus/ dngul bre chen lnga la bcos pa'i thod pa lngar bsgrubs pa'i lo rgyus kyang gsungs/ bshad pas de lta bu'i thod pa lnga/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ dbus kyi thod pa'i dpral ba shar du bstan/ phyogs kyi rnams dbus ma la bstan pa'i dbus kyi thod par mi'i sha de bzhin shar du ba glang gi sha lhor khyi'i sha nub tu rta'i sha byang du glang po che'i sha rnams thod pa so sor bkod/

bdud rtsi lnga chang ngam dri chu la sbyar te/ sha lnga po de dag la bskus te sbags/ gzhan yang dri chu'i brda gla rtsi mang na dri nga zhing khrag mkhris la 'phog pas nyung bya/ dbus kyi thod par blug dri chen gyi brda a ru ra nad mtha' dag sel zhing bcud len du 'gyur bas mang bar byas te gzhi blang ngo / /gser mdog rus pa dang phral ba'i shun pa/ shar gyi thod par rak+ta'i brda du ru ka lhor byang sems dkar po'i brda ga pur mang na rlung la 'phog pas ran par bya/ nub tu sha chen gyi brda tsan+dan dmar po byang gi thod par blug gzhan yang gur las/ kha ba tsha ba rdo rjer dbul/ /dngar ba rdo rje rtag pa la/ /skyur ba rdo rje nyi ma la/ /de bzhin lan tshwa 'jig rten rjer/ /rta yi rgyal po thams cad dam/ /bska ba rab tu brtag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ kha ba'i rigs/ nim pa dang / tig ta dang / tsha ba lga skya dang / pho ril dang / drod sman sogs dbus kyi thod par bu ram/ sbrang rtsi/ shing mngar/ rgun 'brum sogs mngar ba rnams shar gyi thod par/ se 'bru dang / sel yab/ ltar bu/ skyu ru ra sogs ro skyur ba rnams lho'i thod par/ kha ba/ tsha ba/ mngar ba/ skyur ba rnams cha mnyam por bya/ lan tshwa/ rgya tshwa/ rgyam tshwa/ dwa tshwa/ kha ru tshwa sogs tshwa sna'i rigs rnams nub kyi thod par/ de thams cad 'tshogs pa'i mang nyung ji ltar 'tshams pa dang / ba ru ra/ li shi sug smel bla sgang rnams dang / gzhan yang li ga dur sogs ro bska ba rnams byang gi thod par bzhag de bzhin du gur las/ a ka ru nag kyai rdo rje/ /phan pa la ni tsan+dan dkar/ /dmar po 'jig rten rje la dbul/ /kha che rdo rje nyi ma la/ /bdun gyi rgyal po thams cad de/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dbus kyi thod par a ka ru nag po/ de dang rigs mthun gyi dri'i rigs rnams bzhag shar du tsan+dan dkar po la sogs pa'i dri dang / lhor kha che gur gum sogs/ nub tu tsan+dan dmar po/

byang gi thod par de thams cad tshang ba'am/ ji ltar rigs par bzhag gzhan yang kan+dha ka ri/ sle tre/ dbang lag rgya mtsho'i lbu ba/ rus rta'i bye brag sogs sman bzang po ji snyed 'tshogs pa rnams kyang thod pa'i nang du ji ltar rigs par dgod cing / thod pa dbus ma'i rdzas cung zad mang ba dang mtho bar bya zhing / de'i dbus su gser la sogs pa'i snod bzang por bla ma gong ma'i bdud rtsi ril bu chang la sbyar ba'i gta' ma khyad par can bzhag de nas bar chad bsrung phyir thod pa'i kha dang mnyam pa'i zangs ma'am shog bu la khro bo bcu'i srung 'khor man ngag bzhin bris rab gnas bya/ pas thod pa so so'i kha dgab/ tshon sna lnga'i skud pas rgya gram du dkris/ dbus ma la lhag mtho gang tsam lte bar bzhag pa la/ phyogs bzhi'i tshon skud lhag ma rnams mdud pa byas nas dbus kyi lhag la/ rdo rje gzungs thag btags te bzhag thod pa gcig las med na dbus dang phyogs bzhir rdzas rnams ma nor bar bkod la 'khor los kha dgab pa dang / tshon skud dkri ba sogs gong bzhin bya/ thod pa rnams kyi mtha' skor ji ltar mdzes pa'i mchod pa bshams/ stegs bu'i mdun der sbyangs khrus kyi chas rnams kyang dgod/ gnam sa'i rgyan bre ba dang / rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi gdan yang ji ltar rigs par bshams/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na 'og tu bkru ba la dgos pa'i phyir/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'ang bshams/ gzhan yang bkod pa bzang la rgya che zhing mdzes pa phun sum tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul ni/ skabs bzhi las phyi ma red kyi dus su rdo rje slob dpon gyis gtso byas pa'i dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa gsum mam/ bdun nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar ji ltar rigs pa stan la nye bar 'khod de/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na/ sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma nas gzung ste/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma bsngo ba'i bar dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga las 'byung ba bzhin yongs su rdzogs par bya/ bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang 'brel na gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs/ mi grangs dang bstun pa'i zhu 'bul phyag dgu gnyis sam gsum las med na/ ma'am/ bco brgyad ma tshogs pa yod na/ gang 'os bya/ yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bcas pa ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing 'dag bya dag byed ngo sprad pa'i sgo nas legs par bsgom/ dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i tshe dkyus bzhin las/ khyad par srung ba'i 'khor lo mi bsdu bar bzhag he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mchod pa dang gtor ma'i rnal 'byor thun mtshams kyi bya ba ltar yongs su rdzogs par bya/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa sngon du 'du byas pa bum bzlas kyi skabs nas 'byung ba ltar bsgrub/ de nas rdzas rnams la las kyi rdo rjes mtheb kyu chang bu sogs bskor ba dang bstun nas/ zhi ba/ zhi drag phyed ma/ drag pos sbyang ba rnams kyi sgo nas bgegs bskrad/ rdzas la ltos pa'i g.yas dang / g.yon du me dang chu bzhag cing / bdag nyid dang rdzas kyi 'bags rtsogs nyams grib rnams til la bstim ste sngags dang bcas pas mer bsreg cing chur dor bas sdig pa sbyangs/ de nas dkyil 'khor rten rnying pa byin rlabs can me long gi nang du 'char bar byas la/ las bum gyi chus khrus gsol/ chu de bum par blugs nas rdzas rnams la me long bstan te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sh+lau ka gsum gyis khrus byas te dri ma sbyangs/ de ltar sbyang ba gsum sngon du song nas dkyil 'khor rdzas dang bcas pa la dmigs te/ swa bha wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du pho brang zlum po le tshe dgu dang bcas pa'i phyogs bzhir pam̐ las byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa re re/

de dag gi lte bar ā yig dkar po yongs su zhu ba las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa lnga'i shar gyi thod par go las rnam snang gi ngo bo ba glang gi sha lhor ku las rin 'byung gi ngo bo khyi'i sha nub tu da las snang mtha'i ngo bo rta'i sha byang du ha las don 'grub kyi ngo bo glang po che'i sha dbus kyi thod par na las mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo mi'i sha sha lnga po de dag re re'i steng du'ang bdud rtsi lnga lnga bsam ste/ shar du me long ye shes kyi ngo bo bi las dri chen/ lhor mnyam nyid ye shes kyi ngo bo ra las rak+ta/ nub tu sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo shu las byang sems/ byang du bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bo ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo mu las dri chu/ sman dang rdzas gzhan rnams kyang oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du bsam nas/ thod pa dbus ma'i gzungs thag slob dpon gyi phyag tu dbul/ bla mas gzungs thag gi lhag gzhan rnams la gtad de/ sems kyi dmigs pa rang he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du ye shes lnga ldan gyi hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros lus gang bas sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams bsregs/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer kha dog lnga pa snying kha nas thon/ gzungs thag la zhon te song bas/ 'od zer gyi rtse las mchod pa'i yo byad dpag med 'phros pas/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor lha dang sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro grub pa rig 'dzin gyi tshogs thams cad mnyes par byas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka dang / spros pa'i 'od zer las bdud rtsi'i rgyun char lta bu babs pa rdzas rnams la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam pa spyi'i dmigs pa gsal ba dang / khyad par shar gyi ba glang gi sha de nyid rnam snang gi rang bzhin gzugs phung sbyong zhing /

sku'i dngos grub ster ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ ā go hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ ces stong sogs ci rigs pa bzlas/ de bzhin du lhor gnas pa khyi'i sha de nyid rin 'byung gi rang bzhin tshor ba'i phung po sbyong zhing / stobs sogs yon tan gyi dngos grub ster ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ āḥku hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes dang / nub kyi rta'i sha de nyid 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin 'du shes kyi phung po sbyong zhing gsung gi dngos grub ster ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ āḥd hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes dang / byang gi glang po che'i sha de nyid don grub kyi rang bzhin 'du byed kyi phung po sbyong zhing 'phrin las kyi dngos grub ster ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ āḥha hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes dang / de bzhin du dbus su mi'i sha de nyid mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyong zhing / thugs kyi dngos grub ster ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ āḥn hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes dang / de nas sha lnga po de nyid rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang / rigs dang dngos grub mtha' dag gsal ba sgron ma lnga'i bdag nyid du bsam zhing sha lnga spyi la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥmahā pañca mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ de rjes sha lnga'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga tshan lnga dmigs pa'i shar gyi cha rnams su gnas pa'i dri chen de dag rnam snang dang spyan ma'i rang bzhin/ gti mug sbyong zhing lus kyi mdangs stobs ster ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ āḥbi hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes dang / lho phyogs rnams su gnas pa'i rak+ta de nyid rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rang bzhin nga rgyal dang ser sna sbyong zhing / rgas pa med pa'i dngos grub ster ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ āḥr hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ nub kyi byang sems de dag 'od dpag med yab yum gyi rang bzhin 'dod chags sbyong zhing /

tshe'i dngos grub ster ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ āḥshu hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ byang du gnas pa'i sha chen gyi dwangs ma de dag don grub yab yum gyi rang bzhin phrag dog sbyong zhing / dpal dang dbang phyug sogs ster ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ āḥm hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ dbus rnams su gnas pa'i dri chu de dag mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rang bzhin zhe sdang sbyong zhing / nad thams cad sel ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mu phaṭ swāhā/ de nas bdud rtsi lnga spyi la dmigs te/ 'chi med kyi tshe sogs thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad ster ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ āḥmahā pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ rdzas gzhan rnams de nyid gsum las bskyed pa las 'od 'phros snod bcud ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i tshogs bkug ste de dag la thim pas nus mthu dang ldan par bsam la yi ge gsum mang du bzla/ thun 'jog khar gsung mi chag par bya ba'i phyir/ gcig gam gsum la sogs pa la gzungs thag gtad de/ dmigs pa sngar bzhin la/ sngags rnams rgyun ma chad par bzla/ rnal 'byor gzhan gsum la sogs pas bar chad bsrung ba'i ched du bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa grol mtshams/ sum+bha ni'am/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i sngags sgrub pa rdzogs pa'i bar gsung mi chag tu bzla ba gnad du che bar gsungs/ dpon slob gzhan rnams kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyod/ rjes kyi bya ba gzhung bzhin du bya ste thun gcig gi bya ba'o/ /de ltar nyin zhag phrugs re la thun drug gam/ bzhir bcad de dam tshig dang mi ldan pa'i mi nang du mi gzhug mtshams shin tu dam par bcad de bsgrub/ thun re'i gzhug tu tshogs 'khor grub na rab/ ma 'byor na thun thog mtha' la gnyis/ de'ang ma grub na srod thun la tshogs 'khor re med du mi rung / skabs 'dir rnal 'byor ba'i lugs kyi tshogs 'khor nges par dgos gsungs/ de ltar zhag bdun la sogs pa ci rigs par sgrub pas/

gnas khang gzi brjid che ba dang 'od chags pa/ dkyil 'khor rten mchod la sogs pa bkrag mdangs che zhing sman rnams kyang sngar las dri bsung bzang ba dang ldan pa de'i tshe phyi ma'i sgrub pa la 'jug par bya ste/ gong bu bsgrub pa'i skabs so/ /de nas phye ma bsgrub pa ni/ rdo rje pad+ma'i rang bzhin gyi/ /stan dang gtun gyis rab sbyangs pa/ /snod gcig blugs nas ji bzhin du/ /bskyed nas sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ /khyad par yang ni 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar snga thun gyi lhag gtor yan chad grub nas/ rjes chog ma zin pa'i bar der rdo rje slob dpon gyis lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas thod pa'i tshon skud rnams shar nas rim pas bkrol te/ srung 'khor dang bcas pa rang rang gi gnas dang / dbus kyi thod pa'i rta ma'ang der bzhag dbus kyi thod pa slob dpon gyis dang / gzhan rnams sgrub grogs so sos khyer nas gnas khang de nyid dam/ gzhan ji ltar 'os pa 'tshams khongs su tshud pa'i sar rdo'i stan pa 'jam mkhregs gtun bu dang bcas pa/ las bum gyi chus dag par bkru/ gu gul a ka ru sogs kyis bdug cing bgegs bskrad/ rgyud du/ rdo rje thod pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /zhes pa'i don yin pas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs te/ stan pa a las chos 'byung gi rang bzhin pad+ma bhañja na/ gtun bu hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga par bsam/ bdag nyid he ru kar gsal bas brdungs shing rdo rje dang pad+ma srub par bsgom/ srub mtshams nas bde ba'i sgra/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī bya a mṛ ta bh+rum̐ am̐ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ zhes 'byin par mos/ ngag tu'ang de ltar bzlas te/ sman 'thag dka' ba rnams thog mar btag dza ti dang ltar bu sogs snum gsher dang ldan pa rnams rjes la 'thag sems kyi dmigs pa rdo rje pad+ma mnyam par sbyor ba'i mtshams nas/ bde chen ye shes kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi skya chil chil byung bar bsam/ dar la sogs pa la btsags te shin tu zhib par bya/

de dag gi bar rnams su'ang bsrung ba'i sngags rgyun ma chad pa gal che/ phye ma zhib par byas pa de dag sngar gyi thod pa rnams su blug thod pa dbus pa'i gta'ang sngon ltar bzhag tshon skud dkri ba gzungs thag sogs gong bzhin byas te so so'i gnas su bkod nas/ bsgrub pa ni gnas yo byin gyis brlabs pa nas mchod gtor dang sbyang ba gsum gyi bar rgyas par nyams su blangs/ bskyed pa'i tshe gzhan gong bu'i skabs bzhin las/ khyad par yi ge lnga bsgom ste/ shar gyi thod par gnas pa'i sha dang / bdud rtsi'i steng du me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bh+rūm̐ yig dkar po/ de bzhin du lhor aṃ ser po mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ dmar po so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ ljang khu bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ sngon po chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang bzhin gsal btab/ bzlas pa'i dus spyi dang bye brag gi dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra ba las/ sngags kyi khyad par/ oṃ āḥgo go ru mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥku ku ru mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥd da dha mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥha hasti mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥn na ra mam̐ sa hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes sha lnga'i sngags dang / oṃ āḥbi ta a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥr ga ta a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥshu kra a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥmasti ka a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥmu tra a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa bdud rtsi lnga'i sngags te so sos ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi yi ge lnga 'od zer gzi brjid 'bar ba las 'od 'phros/ 'khor 'das brtan g.yo ma lus pa'i byin rlabs dang bdud rtsi'i bcud mtha' dag bsdus/ rdzas rnams la thim par bsam la/ oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐ ā dar+ṣa dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ sa man+ta dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/

oṃ āḥdz+rīṃ pra d+ya bak+ṣa dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ trid+ya anuṣ+ṭha na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dharmā dhā tu dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes so sor mang du bzla/ thun gtong ba'i tshe sngags rgyun 'dzin mi gang yin pa la gzungs thag gtad de gsung mi chag tu bya/ gzhan rnams kyis tshogs 'khor la longs spyod pa nas rjes kyi cho ga'i bar rdzogs par byas te/ de lta'i tshul gyis zhag grangs ci rigs par thun drug gam/ bzhi la sogs par bsgrubs te bsgrubs pa'i rtags gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par du dmigs pa gsal zhing byin phebs pa dang / rdzas rnams las 'od 'phro zhing / dri bzang ba/ rmi lam gyi ltas khyad par can sogs ci rigs pa mthong ba de'i tshe phye ma'i sgrub pa mthar phyin pa yin pas/ skabs gsum pa lde gu'i sgrub pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /de'ang / myos byed tsha ba nying khu ru/ /byas pa la sogs lde gur bya/ /yongs su rdzogs par bskyed nas ni/ /sngar bzhin byin gyis brlab par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas snga thun gyi lhag gtor yan chad grub pa'i rjes su rdo rje slob dpon gyis thod pa rnams gong bzhin kha dbye ste/ phye ma de dag zangs gzhong la sogs pa'i nang du blug chang gtsang ma'i nying khu la tsha ba gsum gyi phye cung zad btab pas sbru/ sngar gyi bdud rtsi ril bu'i gta' ma chang la sbyar ba'ang bsre/ lag pa gtsang mar bkrus pas brdzis 'them zhing cung zad sla bar bya/ de lta bu'i lde gu de dag gong bu ci rigs par bgos te sngar bzhin yang thod par blugs la/ phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar bkod de/ 'khor los kha bcad pa dang / tshon skud dkri ba sogs sngon bzhin bya/ de nas bsgrub pa'i tshul ni/ sbyang ba gsum gyi bar ni sngar bzhin/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su thod pa lnga po re re'ang nang mchod byin rlabs ltar yongs su rdzogs par bskyed/ bzlas pa'i tshe spyi'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin dang 'dra ba las/

khyad par steng gi rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od spro ba'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang / gzhan yang 'khor 'das brtan g.yo ma lus pa kun gyi bcud dang byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas bkug rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas 'od zer gzi brjid dang ldan/ de nyid dang oṃ yig nyi ma dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar na ra ra 'dzag pa 'og gi bdud rtsi rnams dang 'dres pas kha dog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thogs med du ster ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam la/ phye ma'i skabs kyi sngags rnams so so ci rigs pa dang / bye brag tu de nyid gsum khri la sogs pa 'jur du bzla/ thun gcod pa'i tshe rang rang gi yan lag drug pa'i mngon rtogs tshar ba bsgom zhing / bdud rtsi byin rlabs gsal gdab cing bya/ snga mas bzlas pa 'jog khar oṃ dang nyi ma rdo rje gsum zhu ste thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de bzhin du thun nam spod pa'i tshe snga mas zhu bar bsam/ phyi mas gsal btab cing bsgom/ gzhan tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs skabs snga ma rnams dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar thun bzhi lta bur bcad de bsgrubs pas lde gu rnams sngar bas che bar 'phel ba dang / sa phyogs mtha' dag dri bsung gis khyab pa de'i tshe ril bu'i sgrub pa la 'jug par bya ste lde gu'i skabs so/ /de nas skabs bzhi pa ril bu'i sgrub pa ni/ snga thun gyi rjes chog yan tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyi lde gu rnams blangs te sgrub g.yog dang bcas pas ril bu sran ma'am yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam ji ltar rigs par bsgril la gur gum gyi chus kha dog bsgyur ba lag len bzhin du bya/ de rnams thod pa lngar blugs te rang rang gi gnas su bzhag 'khor lo dgab pa dang / tshon skud dkri ba sogs mi dgos/

bsgrub tshul lde gu'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin las/ bzlas pa'i tshe de nyid gsum la ha ho hriḥbatags pa kho na bzla/ sems kyi dmigs pa/ oṃ zhes bzlas pa'i tshe sangs rgyas thams cad sku rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs ril bu la thim pas kha dog phun sum tshogs par gyur cing lus zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje lta bu'i sku can gyi dngos grub stsol ba'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ de bzhin du āḥsangs rgyas thams cad gsung rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs thim pas ro bcud phun sum tshogs shing ngag 'gag med kyi dngos grub stsol ba'i ngo bor bsam/ hūm̐ gis thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs thim pas sems rtog med chos skur bsgyur ba'i nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing de'i dngos grub stsol bar mos/ has kha dog ngan pa 'phrogs te kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas 'khor 'das thams cad tshim par byed pa'i nus pa can du/ hos dri ngan pa bshigs te khyad par can dang ldan pas 'khor 'das kun tshim byed du byin gyis brlabs/ hris 'bras bu ngan pa thams cad bshigs te nus pa phun sum tshogs pas 'phags pa rnams kyi zag pa med pa'i dbang po rnams mnyes pa dang / sems can thams cad tshim par byed pa'i nus pa mchog dang ldan par bsams/ thun 'jog khar ril bu'i steng gi nam mkhar tshe dpag med zhal sbyor gyi rnam par gsal btab pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun dpag med byung ba ril bu rnams la thim pas rdo rje tshe'i rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub stsol ba'i ngo bor bsam zhing / gong ma'i sngags so so'i mthar/ a yu puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ dang / oṃ pu ṇ+ya'i bzlas pa mang du bya/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang rjes kyi cho ga gzhung ltar nyams su blangs/ thun bzhir bcad de 'di ni zhag gcig gam gsum la sogs pa ci rigs skabs dang sbyar bas chog pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i sgrub pa rdzogs pa dang /

phud kyi lha mchod pa'i phyir grub na rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya/ sreg rdzas kyi skabs su ril bu brgya dang brgyad spel tshig dang bcas pas dbul/ de nas thod pa'i nang gi ril bu rnams bsdus la bla mas gsum 'gyur ram lnga 'gyur du tshags bya/ gzhan grogs rnams la'ang ci rigs par sbyin par bya/ yo byad sbyor ba'i yon bdag yod na skal ba mang du sbyin/ gzhan don du gnyer ba rnams la'ang ci rigs pa sbyin par bya/ de nas de rnams so so rang rang gi za ma tog la sogs pa'i snod bzang por blugs la bkur bsti cher bya'o/ /gsum pa ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul ni/ rab thun bzhi'i thog mtha' la re re ste brgyad/ yang na thun gyi thog mar re re ste bzhi nges par bsten/ 'bring gis thun thog mtha' gnyis la re re bsten/ mtha' mas kyang thun dang po la re re bsten/ de'ang ma grub na zla ba drug la re re bsten/ gal te de'ang ma 'byor na/ lo re'i dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig gam bco lnga la re re nges par bsten/ de'i tshe ril bu'i snod par bu sogs/ rnam thar gsum gyi rang bzhin chos 'byung du bsgom/ ril bu rnams rigs lnga dang / ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gsal btab la/ len pa'i tshe rang yi dam du dmigs pa'i lag pa g.yon mthe bong rdo rje dang / srin lag pad+mar bsams la blangs la lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsgom/ ril bu lce thog tu 'jog pa dang / rdo rje pad+ma srub pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi myangs shing mid pas rtsa khams thams cad la khyab ste lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs tshim par bsams la bza' 'o/ /bzhi pa bsten pa'i phan yon ni/ de lta bu'i rdzas de dag shin tu gsang ste thabs ldan gyi cho gas bsten na/ yon tan bla na med pa 'byung bar gsungs te/ gur le'u bdun par/ 'di dag zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun mnyam rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje dang ni mnyam par 'gyur/

/nad rnams thams cad rab tu zhi/ /de ni gzi brjid lus chen po/ /'jig rten kun gyi yid 'phrog pa/ /phas kyi rgol ba kun las rgyal/ /'jig rten kun gyi bdag pos brgyan/ /lha rnams kun gyis 'dren par mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes sha lnga bsten pa'i phan yon dang / de bzhin du bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa'i phan yon yang / mi bskyod bsten pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nad rnams thams cad rnam par spong / /rtag pas chu shel chen por ldan/ /rdo rje nyi mas rgas pa med/ /don yod rgyal po chen po ni/ /rdo rje srog gi yan lag 'byung / /don kun 'grub cing dpal dang ldan/ /de ni rnal 'byor par ni brjod/ /ces gsungs shing khyad par tshe'i bcud len du 'gyur ba dang / de nyid du/ mi bskyod bsrung ba'i sbyor ba las/ /stong phrag lngar ni 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /phan pa yi ni khri ru brjod/ /rdo rje nyi ma rdo rje'i 'bum/ /tshe dpag med kyi dpag med dang / /mdun gyi nam mkha' ji srid bshad/ /ces sogs gsungs pas/ de dag gi don bsdus na gsum ste/ tshe dang lus kyi bcud len du 'gyur ba dang / dug lnga rang gnas su zhi zhing / lam lnga rgyud la bskyed pa dang / dbang bzhi'i lta ba lam du slong bas 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sha lnga bsten pas lus gzi brjid chen po dang ldan zhing / 'jig rten kun gyi yid 'phrog par 'gyur ba dang / bdud rtsi lngas lus kyi nad lnga sel te/ sha chen gyis rlung sel/ rak+tas mkhris pa/ mi bskyod pas bad kan/ byang sems kyis khrag rnam snang gis 'dus pa'i nad mtha' dag sel lo/ /de ltar 'gal rkyen nad rnams sel ba'i stobs kyis skra dkar dang gnyer ma sogs mi 'byung / chu shel ltar bkrag mdangs dang ldan la/ dus min gyi 'chi bas mi tshugs shing tshe yun ring du gnas pa sogs dngos grub 'bad med du 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/

khyi'i shas gti mug sel bas gnyid chung / rta'i shas 'dod chags sel zhing rig pa rno/ mi'i shas ni zhe sdang sel/ sems stobs dang ldan zhing mthu che/ glang po che'i shas phrag dog sel/ gzhan thams cad dbang du 'du/ ba glang gi shas nga rgyal sel/ snying rje skye/ bdud rtsi lngas ye shes lnga'i rtog pa rgyud la 'char la/ de ltar dug lnga gnas su zhi bas lam lnga rgyud la skyes te skyon mtha' dag sel lo/ /gsum pa ni/ tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu myangs pas phung po lnga sbyong zhing / rgyal ba rigs lngas gnas 'gyur snang stong zung 'jug gi rtogs pa bskyed pas bum dbang gi lta ba lam du slong / mgrin par myangs te rtsa khams thams cad la khyab pas gsal stong gnyis med kyi rtogs pa skye bas gsang dbang gi lta ba lam du slong / byang sems cher rgyas te bde stong zung 'jug gi rtogs pa skye bas dbang gsum pa'i lta ba lam du slong / bdud rtsi de nyid bsten pas sha lnga sogs gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par rtog pas bzang ngan dang spang blang gi rnam par rtog pa dang bral zhing / bde stong mchog gi ting nge 'dzin skye bas bzhi pa'i lta ba lam du slong / lta ba bzhi lam du bslong bas grub mtha' bzhi mthar phyin te/ 'bras bu sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur te/ mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub mtha' dag 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje btsun rin po che dang / chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas mdzad pa'i gsung rab la gzhi blangs/ 'brom des pa ston chung / gyis mdzad pa'i gsang bcu'i yig cha nas kyang ci rigs pa kha bskangs/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis brgyan nas/ gong ma'i dgongs pa gsal bar bya ba'i ched du/ 'khon gyi rigs can blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpe 'khyud spangs te khyi'i lo gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyin grub pa'i gnas mchog kha 'ub bskyed lhas su legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo gsal lhun grub rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis so/

/phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces pa de rnams kyis bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas// ༈ //spyi don bzhi pa mus chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ chos kyi rje mtshungs pa med pa'i 'phrin las kyi dbang phyug 'jig rten mgon po dang mi gnyis pa'i thugs mnga' ba chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu'i bsgrub tshul la/ sa lo chen po yab sras rnams kyis mchan bu gnang ba dang bcas pa'i gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ glegs bam dkar chag tu bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rang gis mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i cho ga gzhir bzhag pa la/ sngon du yo byad bshams pa ni/ ril bu dkyus na bshad pa ltar gyi brda lnga'i sman gang 'grub la/ 'bras bu gsum gtso bor bsags/ de rnams phye mar zhib tu btag bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang / thod pa'i zhal shar la sogs pa'i gnas khang dang bstun/ rdo rje slob dpon de dang zhal sprod byed/ ka pā la lnga'i du 'byor pa sogs/ nang du phye ma rnams blug khro bcu'i srung 'khor bris pa'i rab gnas spyi ltar byas pa 'byor na thod pa re la re re/ ma 'byor na spyi ru che gcig shog phras kha nas dgab/ skud pa ser po rdo rje mdud pa gsum btab pa'i ring ba gnyis kyis thams cad bskor la/ rgya gram du dkri/ gzhi bzang po'i steng du bzhag de'i 'gram du mchod pa'i nang gi zur gcig tu mañji'i steng du bzhag bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun du/ chu bzhi thod pa'i mtha' la gru bzhir bkod/ sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod gtor ma lnga tshar phyag len rang rang gi lugs gang yin byas chog dang bcas pa bshams/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad/ ma ma da ba la chang dang sha la zer te tshogs kyi skabs su tha de bas lhag pa gsung phyin sha chang gi lhag ma shor ram/

mal gyi dngos ming brjod mi nyan pa'i phyir/ ku bag can zhes pa kun gyis go tshor med pa gsang zhing sba ba yin te/ sngon gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing sdom brtson dam pa byang chub kyi lam mngon du mdzad nges pa sku skye ba dpag med nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i zas dkar gsum kho na la mdzad pa dag kha na ma tho spang phyir dang / khyad par dbang ma thob pa sogs kyis mthong mi nyan te/ deng sang rang re rnams spyod pa khyi phag ltar byed sha chang bag med spyod phyin dgos pa dang bral gda'/ dkyil 'khor rnams 'jig rten pa kun la ngom pa byed skabs tshogs rdzas phran tshegs su 'dug 'on kyang sdom ldan gyi lugs rnams de ltar dgongs las/ sa skya pa tshogs byed pa yin zhes ltas ngan la rang gsang med pa'i byur la ngom so ma byed par gsang gang thub mdzod/ dge ldan pa tshul 'chos yin zer te/ de bzhin sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa bzhin/ 'jig rten ma dad gyur pa rnams/ /gnyis ka mthun rnams 'bad pas bsrungs/ /zhes gsungs gda' ba ma tshor ba/ da na dang ba la sogs pa kun bag can dang 'brel ba bsags/ gzhan yang bla bre dang yol ba la sogs pa dang / bris sku la sogs pa'i rten bshams pa spyi dang mthun/ dam tshig cung zad nyams pa'i the tshom can dang / lam dus chag pa rnams la dgos/ gang ltar slob dpon rang la brnyas bcos mi byed cing blo mthun pa nang gtsang tshad thub pa gal che/ gso ba'i ched du bla mas sgrub rogs rnams la lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ sgrub pa po rnams kyi mdun du nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu phyag len gos bzang sogs/ bzhin bshams/ dus sa ga zla byung na nges pa can yin/ sman mang zhing dpon slob nyung na zhag nyi shu zla phyed/ sa ga zla ba tshang ma gang dgos byed/ grol ba gnam gang gi snga thun nas byed dgos so/ /de yang phye ma la zhag gsum/ gong bu la zhag gsum/ de lhag ril bu bsgril/

de bar srod thun thor thun ma chag pa/ bsgril tshar rim gyis thod par blug 'khor lo bkab pa sogs byed/ bsgril ring la yang ngag mi gtong ba 'bru gsum dang sum+bha ni dal med 'don gyin byed/ ba la sogs pa'i nyer gsum nas dbu 'dzugs pa/ kyai rdo rje'i bsnyen pa song grangs bsnyen song nges dgos/ ba'i sgrub pa po dpon slob bdun sogs du 'byor pa/ bdun mdun bskyed la kha phyogs par bsdad/ de nas sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i dngos gzhi ni/ nyi shu gsum gyi dgong thun la babs pa dgong thun srod thun gang / na maṇ+ḍal zhu tshogs 'khor byed dus min pa thun gsum las mi dgos/ gnas yo byin rlabs tsam gyis chog 'bul nas brtsams te/ mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug pa bzlas pa'i bar thub tshad mar bsgom/ dkyil 'khor bsdus te mdun bskyed kyi maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod gtor bsngo yan chad thun gsum gtor bsngo bsdus pa re mdzad/ sum+bha ni bzla mkhan gyi tshogs dang bstun pa'i thun ma gtogs gtor bsngo mdun bskyed mi dgos/ kyi bar rdzogs par bya/ thun bzhi char la tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed na skabs thor thun dgong thun rgyas pa/ srod thun gung thun bsdus pa/ 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang bya/ rje mus chen gyi phyag len la dgong thun dang bstun gung tshigs la tshogs re mdzad/ tho rangs kyi thun dang bstun/ tsha bzhes rjes chog ma byas pa ched kyis mdzad pa re mos so/ /kyi skabs su tshogs re mdzad pa gda'/ de nas thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams bdud rtsi byin rlabs rgyas pa bya/ steng gi oṃ dang rdo rje'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun mi chad par babs pa la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ci 'grub bzla/ sgrub pa po gcig gis bdun yod na gnyis byas pa legs/ bar chad bsrung ba'i sum+bha ni ci 'grub dang / gzhan rnams kyis bzlas pa re mos thun spod pa'i tshe snga mas steng gi rdo rje nyi ma oṃ rnams zhu nas bstim/

phyi mas bdud rtsi byin rlabs la gsal btab cing bzlas/ spyod lam gyi shugs kyis lang dgos byung na'ang de bzhin shes par bya'o/ /kyis gsung mi chag mtshan la'ang phyed lang gi nyal res byed/ tu byed pa dkyus bzhin/ zhag gsum song ba'i thor thun dang tsha ba grol nas/ snga thun thon nas phye ma rnams chang thod pa sa bre tsam dgu la bdun ril re dgos/ gar po dang / bdud rtsi ril bu'i gta' dang bcas pas sbrus bdud rtsi ril bu'i gta' dang / kha che gi hang bung tshe ba/ gla rtsi dri thon/ dros sman/ pho ril/ bcas lgang gsum cung zad bsres pa zhib par btags pa chang la sbyar bas phye ma gzhong par sbrus nas cung zad bska tsam byed/ nas gong bur lde gu yin/ bcas te thod pa so sor bgos nas bzhag sngar bzhin srung 'khor srung skud dang bcas pas bsdams/ dpon slob rnams kyis dgong thun nas brtsams te/ zhag gsum gong ltar bsgrub/ zhag gsum gyi snga thun thon nas dpon slob thams cad nyi ma gcig pu lde gu rnams stan du gtun gyis 'dam btags 'them par byed/ dmigs pa ni stan pa a las pad+ma/ gtun hūm̐ las rdo rjer bsams la rdung mkhan he ru kar gsal bas mnye zhing rdo rje dang pad+ma srub pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi skya chil chil byung bar bsam/ de nas ril bu sran ma'am yungs kar tsam ji ltar rigs pa bsgril lo/ /la ril bu bsgril/ de nas thod pa so sor bzhag ste 'khor los bsdams pa la sogs sngar dang 'dra/ srod thun nas brtsams te sang snga thun gyi bar gsung mi chag tu bzlas pa sngar dang 'dra/ sgrub pa'i tshad zhag po bdun po de yin/ de nas gnam gang nyin chos skyong la gtang rag bla ma dang sgrub pa po rnams la dga' ston gyis tshim par bya/ de dag gi bar la mtshams bsdams shing / mi gtsang ba la 'dzem pa gal che/ zhes pa dge slong sangs rgyas rin chen gyis bris pa'o/

/zhes pa de rnams kyis mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas// ༈ //spyi don lnga pa sbas pa'i rnal 'byor 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ snyan rgyud gdams pa'i gter chen/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po grub chen chos kyi rje dpal ldan bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub tshul gyi gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ grub pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa bka' drin gyi sgo nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad pas kyang lhag par bka' drin can rnams kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo la tshe rabs thams cad du gus pas btud de phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos dus thams cad du rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ 'dir dam tshig gi rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa la/ gnas dben par sngon 'gro rdzas dang yo byad bsags pa/ sgrub pa po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnams kyis cho ga'i rim pa gsum ji ltar du bya ba/ rjes sgrub pa grol nas chos skyong la gtang rag dang bla ma dang sgrub pa po rnams dga' ston gyis tshim par bya ba/ rdzas de nyid bsten pa'i phan yon nam/ dgos pa bshad pa dang bzhi'o/ /dang po gnas ni/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa sogs kyis shin tu dben pa/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis byin gyi brlabs shing shin tu nyams dga' ba'i gnas su mtshams dam du bcad de chag chag gdab/ bla bre yol ba sogs kyis brgyan/ byin rlabs kyi rten gzi 'od 'bar ba'i mdun du gzhi bzang po la/ mañji'i steng du tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i mthar spyi mchod sgos mchod rgyas par bsham pa'i/ shar gyi phyogs dbang ldan nas me'i bar la/ gtor ma lnga tshar gyi mdun du chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / tshogs 'khor shin tu rgyas par bshams pa'i mdun du gzhi bzang po'i steng du 'bru sna lnga/

sman sna tshogs dang dar zab sogs kyi steng du thod pa lnga bzhag pa'i dpral ba rnams bla ma la bstan pa'am/ yang na thams cad shar la bstan pa'am/ yang na dbus ma'i dpral ba shar ram bla ma la bstan/ thod pa gzhan bzhi po'i dpral ba dbus ma la bstan pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i dod kyi sman bsags gsungs kyang / deng sang gi phyag len la sman thams cad kyi mchog a ru ra stobs gang che/ ba ru ra/ skyu ru ra gnyis ji ltar 'tshams pa/ tsan+dan dmar po yang stobs gang che/ tsan+dan dkar po yang ji ltar 'tshams pa/ bzang po drug dang / a ka ru/ rus ta rnams ji ltar mtshon pa/ ga pur dang gla rtsi mtshon pa/ gi hang rnams shin tu zhib par mnyes te/ thod pa rnams kyi nang du blugs la shog bu gtsang ma la phyi rol tu rdo rwa me ris dang bcas pa'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu bris pa'i rtsibs bcu dang / lte ba la hūm̐ bcu gcig bris/ lte ba dang rtsibs kyi bar gyi mu khyud la uṣ+ṇi'i sngags rdzogs pa dang hūm̐ bcu rnams yig mgo phyir bstan pa bris/ rab gnas gzhan dang mthun par byas pa rnams kyis thod pa lnga'i kha bcad la/ skud pa ser pos rgya gram du shin tu dam par dkris la/ gu gul gyi dud pa dang / sum+bha ni sogs kyi sngags brjod do/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnams kyis cho ga rim pa gsum ji ltar bya ba la/ grub na dam tshig gsol ba'i ched du lam gyi dbang bya/ dam tshig dang ldan pa sgrub pa po bdun gyis sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ba ni dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang byin po khyad par med/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dpal kyai rdo rje'i tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang / ril bu'i sgrub pa zab mo bgyid par 'tshal na/ dkar phyogs la dgyes pa'i srung ma sogs gzhan rnams khyad par med/ maṇ+ḍal zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad nas brtsams te/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug rdzogs pa blangs nas/ dkyil 'khor bsdus te mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/

tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dur khrod rnams gsal btab/ lha rnams kyang snying po tshig tsam las dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ mchod bstod dgug gzhug bya/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ mchod bstod gsol btab dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa rnams dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi lha sta gon ji lta ba bzhin du rgyas par bya'o/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /sogs dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /sogs dang / thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /sogs sh+lau ka gsum gyis phyag bya/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /sogs chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo rnams tshigs bcad lnga phyag rgya dang bcas te rgyas par 'bul/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa yang gsung rgyun gyi yig chung bzhin rgyas par 'bul/ dkar mo ri dwags dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor mas mchod cing bstod/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /sogs kyis kyang rgyas par bstod/ spros pa la mi dga' na de tsam gyis kyang chog mod/ rje btsun bla ma'i gsung dang / dam pa rnams kyi phyag len la/ bdun rnam dag dang / rigs lnga'i sdom bzung dang / rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad/ las dang po pa'i bsgrub pa'i dam tshig bcu bdun po'i gzhung rnams 'don pa 'di so so'i gang zag gi nyams len la shin tu gal che ste/ bdun rnam dag gi sgo nas nyes ltung rnams bshags pa dang / sdom gsum gyi dam tshig sdom pa bzung zhing spel ba dang / rtsa ba'i ltung ba sogs kyi gzhung brjod pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos gsungs par bsam zhing / rang gis 'di rnams rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin srung sdom tshul bzhin du byed snyam pas sdom sems byas pas/ dam tshig dang sdom pa gong 'phel du 'gyur ba yin zhes gsungs/ de nas mchod pa dang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/

'das gtor nas brtsams te mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi bar gtor ma'i rim pa rnams rdzogs par phul/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ phud bla ma dang yi dam la 'bul/ rnal 'byor pa rnams tshogs la rol te/ lhag ma btang ba'i bar tshogs kyi gzhung bzhin bya/ de nas sman thams cad zhib par btags nas thod pa'i nang na yod pa des/ sa ga'i nyer gsum la dgong thun la gong gi cho ga de rnams sngon du song nas gu gul gyi dud pa btang / thod pa rnams la nang mchod gtor te/ dpon slob thams cad kyis byin rlabs rgyas par byas te/ gcig gis bar chad bsrung ba'i sum+bha ni ci 'grub bzla/ dpon slob gzhan drug gis re mos kyis gsung mi chag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ci 'grub bzla/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs kyi tshe rdo rje nyi ma oṃ yig rnams 'og gi bdud rtsi la mi bsre bar/ oṃ dang hūm̐ las bdud rtsi 'dzag par bsam nas/ bzlas pa bsdud pa'i tshe 'og gi bdud rtsi la bsre ba yin/ gzhan dmigs pa ni/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dpag tu med pa byon nas rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ dang oṃ mgo thur bltas las bdud rtsi'i rgyun thod pa rnams kyi nang du skya chil li li babs pas/ thod pa stong gsum gyi rgya tsam du gnas pa rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis me re re khengs par bsam pa yin/ zhag gsum song ste/ nyi shu drug gi snga thun rdzogs pa dang / sman phye ma rnams chang gar ma dang lhan cig sbrus te gong bur byas pa la/ bla ma gong ma'i bdud rtsi ril bu la sogs pa khyad par can rnams bsres te thod pa so sor bgos la 'khor los kha bcad de/ srung skud dkri ba sogs gong bzhin bya/ dgong thun nas brtsams te zhag gsum gong ltar bsgrubs te/

nyer dgu'i snga thun rdzogs pa dang / dpon slob thams cad kyis phyogs gcig tu che chung ji ltar 'os pa'i ril bu bsgril te thod pa so sor bgos te blug gong bzhin 'khor los bsdams pa sogs byas la/ dgong thun nas brtsams te gnam gang gi snga thun bar gsung mi chag tu bzlas pa sngar dang 'dra/ dus nges pa can sa ga'i nyer gsum nas/ gnam gang gi bar sgrub pa'i tshad zhag po bdun po de yin/ de'i bar la thun bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos la/ grub na thun bzhi ka la tshogs 'khor re bya/ de tsam ma nus na thog mtha' gnyis la bya/ de'ang ma nus na dgong thun tshugs pa'i nub dang / gsum pa bsgrub pa grol nas/ chos skyong la gtang rag dang / bla ma dang sgrub pa po rnams dga' ston gyis tshim par bya ba ni/ grol ba'i mthar tshogs kyi 'khor lo cis kyang bya dgos pa yin/ gzhan yang chos srung la gtor tshogs rgya chen po dang / sgrub pa po rnams tshogs 'khor gyis mnyes par bya ba dang / ril bu'i skal ba yang ji ltar rigs pa byin nas/ ril bu gzhan rnams snod bzang por blug gos dar la sogs pas gril nas rgya byas te dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung ngam/ gnas dben par bzhag mchod pa byas pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab na mang por 'phel ba yin/ bzhi pa rdzas de nyid bsten pa'i phan yon nam dgos pa bshad pa ni/ de lta bu'i ril bu byin rlabs can de nyid/ rab nyin zhag re la thun bzhir byas pa'i thog mtha' gnyis la re re ste brgyad bsten/ 'bring na thun bzhi la re re ste bzhi bsten/ tha ma thun thog mtha' re la re re ste gnyis sam/ de tsam ma grub na snga thun dang po la gcig bsten/ de'ang ma grub na zla ba re'i nya stong brgyad gsum la re re bsten/ de'ang ma grub na zla ba shar res kyi tshes gcig la re re bsten/ de'ang ma grub na lo re la re re bsten/ de ltar bsten pas nyon mongs pa lnga/ nad lnga/ gdon lnga 'joms shing /

mkha' 'gro lnga dbang du 'dus shing / rigs lnga/ ye shes lnga/ yum lnga'i go 'phang 'thob/ gnas skabs su tshe ring nad med/ dbang po gsal/ rgas kha sra/ lus bde zhing rig pa dwangs/ ting nge 'dzin rang shugs kyis skye ba yin/ 'di lta bu'i bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i lag len cho ga'i rim pa rnams/ phyi rabs rnal 'byor pa don du gnyer ba dang skal ba mtshungs pa rnams kyi don du shākya'i dge slong dpal ldan bkra shis kyis gsal bar bris pa'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis sbas pa'i rnal 'byor 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas// ༈ //spyi don drug pa snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ khams gsum gyi bla ma/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/ srid pa gsum gyi 'dren mchog dam pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba dpal sa skya pa chen po snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed kun gyi gtsug rgyan sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub tshul/ las dang po la mkho ba zhes bya ba las/ 'di ltar 'byung ste/ na mo gu ru ā nan+da puṇ+ya ya/ sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /kun dga'i mtshan can zhabs la phyag btsal nas/ /mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen gyi/ /dam rdzas ril bu bsgrub pa'i lag len bshad/ /de la rgyun du bsten pa'i bza' ba'i dam tshig ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ na dang ga ha dang po dang / /mtha' yi sha dang dang po'i sha /kyai yi rdo rje'i dngos grub phyir/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang de bzhin bza'/ /zhes pa la brten nas dam tshig gi rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub tshul gyi phyag len gsal bar brjod na/ lam 'bras glegs bam na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa ltar nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pa nus pa dang ldan pas rdzas rnams bdud rtsir bsgyur nus pa rnams kyis sha lnga/

bdud rtsi lnga dngos la bya/ bdag 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor par khas 'che zhing / sbyang rtogs sbar gsum mos pa tsam las mi nus pa rnams kyis rje btsun rin po che'i gzhung na gsungs pa ltar gyi brda lnga'i rdzas gang 'grub bya ste/ de yang dri chu'i brda gla rtsi/ dri chen gyi brda a ru ra gser mdog rak+ta'i brda du ru ka ste tsan+dan dmar po 'dra ba la/ de bas cung mi dmar zhing zhib pa/ dri cher med pa/ gar log tsan+dan du grags pa/ yul du ru ka du ru ka yang zer/ nas yong ba 'di legs/ byang sems dkar po'i brda ga bur/ sha chen gyi dwangs ma klad pa'i brda tsan+dan dmar po'o/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dngos ni bla ma gong ma'i bdud rtsi ril bu'i gta' la yod pas ma tshang ba'i skyon med/ gzhan yang a ru ra gang rnyed/ ba ru ra/ skyu ru ra rnams kyi rus pa med pa sha kho na/ lga/ drod sman/ pho ril/ ma nu/ kan+dha ka ri/ sle tre/ lga skya/ sha pho tu ta/ khyi la ba ri/ se 'bru/ sug smel/ rgun 'brum/ shel ka ra/ bye ma ka ra sogs sman gyi rigs gang rnyed tsha grang snyoms pa/ a ka ru/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ kha che gi wang / dza ti/ li shi sogs dri bzang gi rigs gang mang la bya zhing / gtso bor a ru ra gser mdog gi sha dang / kha che/ gi wang gsum ltos gang che rang bzang / ga pur dang / gla rtsi dri thon tsam las mang ba mi legs/ kha tsha ba dang / skyur ba dang / lañcha'i rigs sna yod tsam las mi gtong / 'byor na dbang lag ltos che yi bzang / gzhan thams cad cha snyoms pa rang legs/ rnal 'byor pa rang dang / grogs dag kyang kyai rdo rje'i dus dang grangs kyi bsnyen pa tshad du 'khyol ba/ kha skong gi sbyin sreg sogs cha tshang song ba bdun nam/ brgyad/ gsum mam/ bzhi grab byas la bzhag go /de nas gnas khang ni bla ma gong ma'i sgrub gnas byin rlabs can nam/ yid du 'ong zhing gzhi bdag lha 'dre gdug pa can med pa'i sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas khang du phyag dar byas la bla bre dang yol ba sogs yod na brgyan par bya/

bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku sogs sku gang 'byor bzhugs pa'i mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs pa la dam rdzas gtor ma zlum gtor bdun tshar/ bskang gso byed na gang dgos bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / tshogs 'khor nam byed dus nyer spyod lnga la sogs zhib tu bsham/ slob dpon dang nye ba'i mdun du stegs gru bzhi dar ras la sogs pa gang 'byor dkar pos dgab/ de'i steng du nas 'bras sogs 'bru dkar po ji ltar rigs pa gcal du bkram pa'i steng du srung skud ser po shin tu ring ba rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum btab pa gnyis rgya gram du brkyangs la bzhag pa'i dbus su thod pa gcig slob dpon la dpral ba bstan la bzhag gzhan du yod dbus kyi thod pa la dpral ba bstan nas 'khor mor bsham/ thod pa yang mi thod ni ya 'ud chen po rang zhig yong gi 'dug pas/ rdza'i thod pa rang shis so/ /rdza sogs su rung ba'ang / sdom 'byung gi rgyud las gsungs/ grangs ni/ gzhung las/ ka pā li'i snod gcig gam/ lngar so sor bzhag go /zhes gsungs pa gcig yin na sha lnga phyogs gcig tu 'jog pa la dgongs so/ /mdor na gcig nas brgya sogs gang 'byor yin/ thod pa re re'i nang du'ang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga tshang bar bsam pas chog gong gi rdzas rnams zhib par btags la/ rdza thod grangs du yod bkang la bzhag bla ma gong ma dam pa yin pa/ slob ma mi bslu nges pa'i sku sha yod na a ru ra dang mnyam du nyung ngu nas brdungs shing dar btsags tog zhib byed/ gdung rus/ gdung thal sogs byin rlabs rten 'dres med yid ches nges shes pa rang ma byung bar dag snang sbyong zhes 'dug tshad bsres na/ dam tshig gi skyon gyis phan med gnod pa'i rang bzhin bar chad kyi rgyu rang du 'gyur bas/ 'di pa'i skabs su rtog pa zhib len mdzad dgos/ gzhan yang sman sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad gtsang sbra che zhing yon bdag sogs phyogs nas rdzas yong ba thams cad dam tshig gtsang ba rang gal shin tu che bar myong grub lags pa thugs rtog zhib len ma byas na rdzas la nus pa mi 'byung ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/

rang gi srog la bar chad 'byung nyen che bar gda'o/ /gang ltar gong du bshad pa'i byin rlabs rten rnams gang 'byor yin/ khyad par med thabs med pa bla ma gong ma'i bdud rtsi ril bu'i gta' cung zad re cis kyang dgos so/ /spyod pa dog phyogs pa rnams bla ma'i sku sha la mtshon 'debs pa dang / stan par brdung ba sogs spong bar bshad pa ni ha cang thal te/ rdo rje gur gyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi las tha ma'i cho ga bshad pa dang / slob mas gdung tsha 'debs pa/ bzhu 'bul ba sogs thams cad spong dgos so/ /bdud rtsi ril bu'i gta' dang byin rlabs rten gang 'byor/ kha che/ gi wang mang tsam yod na sman byin dang sbags btags rgyun ring ba rang mdog legs/ nyung na ga pur gla rtsi sogs dri gang zhim rnams dang bcas zhib par btags la/ thod pa so so'i steng du rin po che la sogs pa'i snod ji ltar rigs par cha mnyam du bgos la bzhag pa'am/ snod gcig tu byas dbus sam gang bder bzhag nas lde gu byed dus chang las sbyar nas sman thams cad la khyab pa dgos so/ /de nas uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i srung 'khor 'og tu ji ltar bshad pa bzhin ras sam/ shog bu zangs la sogs pa gang yang rung ba la bris pa rab gnas can thod pa so so'am/ ma 'byor na thod pa thams cad khebs pa'i 'khor lo che ba gcig gang rung gi thod pa'i kha bkab tshar ba dang / 'og gi srung skud ser po rkyang pa de gnyis kyis thams cad bcings par bsam la/ phyogs bzhi nas steng du mdud pa rgya gram du bya/ lhag mas rdza thod rnams kyi mtha' bskor nas bzhag dbus kyi thod pa'i steng du rdo rje gcig la gzungs thag sna lnga shin tu ring ba btags pa bzhag nas/ gzungs thag gi thod pa rnams bskor la lhag sgrub pa po rnams kyi 'dzin pa'i don du bzhag thod pa rnams kyi mtha' skor du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog nas brtsams te chu bzhi'am sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga gru bzhir bshams pa'i nang zur zhig tu bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal kyai rdor lha dgu yum dang bcas pa'i tshom bu bcu bkod pa/

mañji sogs stegs ji ltar rigs pa slob dpon la zhal phyogs par bzhag dpon slob rnams kyi mdun du nang mchod/ rdor dril/ gos zung / slob dpon la bsang chu dung chos nang du dri bzang sbyar ba ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa bkod/ gong du grab byas pa'i sgrub pa po dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa nas/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bar gyi slob ma bsnyen song rang rang gi rgyud ma dkrugs shing mi dkrugs pa/ dam tshig dang sdom pa thob la rags pa ma nyams pa ste/ rang dang dam tshig ma nyams pa gtso bor gal gnad che/ lam dus chag pa dang / dogs pa za ba yod na lam dbang bskur ro/ /bsgrub pa'i tshad ni zhag bdun gyis/ gong bu ni sha lnga sogs dngos su yod pa la dgongs/ 'dir ni phye ma la zhag gsum/ lde gu la zhag gsum/ ril bu la zhag gcig go /dus ni nyi shu gsum nas dgu'i bar bya gsungs pa/ sa ga zla ba'i nyer gsum nas dgu'i bar rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub pa brnyes pa'i dus la dgongs so/ /tshogs 'khor rab kyis drug re nas/ tha mas kyang re re dgos par 'di ni gtso che ba'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ cis kyang sa ga'i zla ba la sgrub pa'i long skabs ma byung tshe/ zla ba gzhan gyi nyer gsum nas gnam gang gi bar bsgrubs kyang rung ba tsam yin te/ sngon rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyis lo lnga bcu nga lngar phebs pa'i me mo yos kyi lo mus bsam gtan phur bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub pa lan snga ma gnang dus/ rje rang dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dpon slob bdun gyis sa ga zla ba'i nyer gsum nas gnam gang gi bar bsgrub par mdzad cing / lan rjes ma sgrub pa gnang dus smin drug zla ba gnyis byung ba'i/ dang po'i nyer gsum nas gnam gang gi bar la rje dpon slob bcu gsum gyis sngar gyi gnas der sgrub pa mdzad pa yin zhes mus chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po nyid kyi rnam thar rgyas pa rnams las 'byung ba'i phyir dang /

chos rje ngor pa lha mchog seng ges kyang e waṃ chos ldan gyi thar pa rtser sgrub pa gnang dus kyang / zla ba bcu pa'i nyer gsum nas dbu bzung / gnam gang gi bar bsgrub par mdzad do/ /zhes rje de nyid kyi rnam thar las 'byung ba dang / rje thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang gis kyang / shing mo lug gi lo'i dbyug pa zla ba dang / me pho stag lo cho 'phrul zla ba gnyis la dam rdzas bsgrub par mdzad pa de nyid kyi rnam thar las bshad pas so/ /gsungs pa ni tshogs 'khor mtshan nyid pa'i phan yon la dgongs kyang / deng sang bza' btung byed shes te/ tshims pa drug gis ting nge 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya sogs lta smos kyang ci dgos/ tshig rkyang tsam yang dka' gnas su gyur pas rnam g.yengs lta bur 'gro ba ma gtogs phan yon cher mi 'dug pas rten 'brel tsam du thog mtha' bar gsum la tshig rkyang gang yong gi tshogs re bya/ gzhan za ma nam bza' dus kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dmigs pa gang yong re byas nas de la bsdu'o/ /sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i dus nyer gsum gyi dgong slob dpon stan la 'dug pa'i mdun du las kyi rdo rjes phyag dang maṇ+ḍal bdun ma phul/ gzhan spyi 'gro las/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad mchod pa'i phyir/ tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i don du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs kyis phul zhing gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod bsang chu la gtor la/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ sham̐ las byung ba'i dung phor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang chu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rdzas la sogs pa'i ma dag pa'i skyon gyi nyes pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/

de wa pi tsu nyer gcig dang / las thams cad pa'i sngags a mṛ ta brgya rtsa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ da lan tshogs thog ma yin pas brda dang brda'i lan bya ba ni/ dbyug sngon can gyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i las kyi rdo rjes bsang chu 'thor yab dang bcas pa khyer/ sgrub khang gi sgo nang du 'dug pa la/ sgrub g.yog pa gzhan rnams kyis khrus byas la phyin nas mgrin gcig tu/ khyod kyi dam tshig la ni dbyug pa sngon po mdzes/ /dngos grub phyag na dbyug tho rin chen bcings pa 'dzin/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo 'dul bar 'khor sgrol 'khums/ /mkha' mdzes rnal 'byor ma yis nang du bdag thongs shig /ces gsol ba btab pa dang sgo cung zad phye la/ dbyug sngon can gyis ka satwam̐ khyod su yin/ m+bho/ zhes dri/ phyi pa rnams kyis ka liñja ram̐ skal ldan lags/ zhes lan btab nas/ po tam̐ phyag 'tshal lo/ /gi zhes brjod/ nang nas pra slar yang phyag 'tshal lo/ ti po tam̐ gi zhes ngag gi brda dang / dbyug sngon can gyis sgo phye nas lag g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo bsgrengs te ston pa 'ong ngam zer/ phyi pa rnams kyis lag pa g.yon pa'i srin mdzub dang mthe chung mthe bos mnan/ gung mo dang mdzub mo gnyis gshibs nas bsgrengs pa bstan te/ bstan pa 'ong nga ོ/ /zhes brda dang brda'i lan byas la nang du btang nas/ dbyug sngon can gyis bsang chu gtor zhing / 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa yang / /rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du zo/ /zhes brjod/ de nas nang du sleb rim gyis slob dpon la phyag byas/ stan nang tshangs can la gral rim gyis 'khod tshar ba dang / las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal nas/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la byin rlabs gnang bar zhu zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis bsang chu dang / rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la gnas yo byin rlabs/

zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad rnams sgrub mchod bzhin dang / skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar lam dus rgyas pa ltar dkyil 'khor bsdus te/ rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/ ces pa'i bar bya/ de nas bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyangs nas/ bstod pa nyi shu pa'i bar maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod ltar byas/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i yi dam gyi gtor bsngo nas brtsams te/ chos skyong sogs rang gang 'bul gyi gtor bsngo/ bskang gso sogs gang dgos rdor glu yan byas nas thun gtor 'bul dgos na phul nas/ tshogs kyi phyir dpon slob thams cad kyis rdo rje dang bcas pas nang mchod nas gnas gsum du reg cing / 'bru gsum brjod pas sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ las kyi rdo rjes mchod par mos la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis logs su bshams pa'i nyer spyod lnga phul bar bsam la/ oṃ bha ga wan mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du gong 'og 'dra ba las/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams nang mchod kyis sbyangs la/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal nas/ tshogs kyi yo byad la byin rlabs gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥmang du brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes snod gtsang ma zhig tu bza' ba dang btung ba thams cad kyi phud bsdus pa cha gnyis su byas te/ cha gcig mdun bskyed kyi maṇ+ḍal dang / cha gcig gtor ma'i mdun du bzhag nas/ phyag gsum phul la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la tshogs kyi phud 'bul ba zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis 'das pa'i gtor sngags dang / chos skyong rnams kyi gtor sngags tshar re brjod nas dbul ba ste tshogs 'khor gyi cha dang po'o/

/de nas rang lhar bsgom pa'i kha hwoṃ khang / lag pa gnyis hūm̐ las dgang blug lte bar ram̐ las me 'bar ba'i dbus su chos skyong sogs 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs/ snying khar pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng du kyai rdor lha dgu'i gtso bo'i dbu steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rigs bdag mi bskyod pa'i tshul du bsgom/ gzhan yang rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad lhar bsgoms la/ rlung ldang 'jug dang bstun nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa cung zad bya zhing / lha'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang tha mal gyi rtog pa 'gyur gang thub bsgom pa ni cha gnyis pa'o/ /las kyi rdo rjes phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub kyi sems cung zad bskyed cing / thal mo sbyar nas/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis tshogs kyi khyad par 'di/ /dang ba'i sems kyis 'bul lags na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis/ e ma ho ye shes chen po rnams/ /tshogs chen 'bar bas nyon mongs bsreg /'di 'dra'i bde ba thob nas ni/ /kun gyi a hoḥsu kha brjod/ /ces dang / thams cad kyis/ a ho su e ma bde ba'i longs spyod ni/ /kha bhak+ṣa ṇa/ a ho su e ma bde ba rab gsal nyid/ /kha pra ma nā/ mahā phyag rgya chen po grub pa ni/ /sa mu dra sid+dhi nam̐/ pra warta nirta nam̐ hūm̐ ha rab tu 'phel ba'i rol gar 'di/ ha ha hoḥ zhes brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes snod chang gis bkang ba dang sha cung zad khyer la slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag nas phyag dang pad skor bya/ gzhan rnams la lag pa g.yas pas snod kyi chang bzung / g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis sha bzung nas/ snod kyi steng du g.yon gyis bskor zhing pad skor gyi rnam pa byas te/ 'dir rnams chos la sogs sh+lau ka gcig po gong bzhin brjod/ de'i lan dpon slob thams cad kyis pad skor dang / bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs/

/gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal/ /a ho su kha/ zhes brjod cing lag gnyis srin lag ma da dang / ba la la reg cing lcer myang tshul bya/ de nas bza' btung tshang ma 'dren dus/ slob dpon phyag sngon du 'gro bas 'dren/ gzhan rnams la phyag mi dgos/ 'dren pa po dang / len pa po gnyis kas lag pa gnyis kyis 'dren cing len pa dang bstun/ a ho su kha zhes brjod cing bya/ bza' btung rnams sa rjen la mi bzhag bza' btung gi phud bla ma dkon mchog la phul/ 'phrog ma la chang bu sbyin/ rang kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bza' 'o/ /ha cang rgyas par mi bza' 'o/ /tshogs rdzas kyi ba la dmigs sha mi rung ngo / /gtso bo la tshogs 'dren pa dang bsdu ba'i dus phyag bya/ sgrub g.yog pa rnams spyod lam gyi shugs kyis 'gro dgos byung na 'gro ba dang / 'ong ba'i dus gtso bo la phyag bya zhing spyod lam byed/ tshogs 'khor gyi dus spyod lam ci byas ma da dang / ba la sogs kyi gleng brjod tsam yang mi byed par gsang thub par bya ba sogs tshogs 'khor gyi bslab bya rgyas pa gsang ba kun rgyan sogs su zhib tu blta zhing spang blang byed pa ni cha gsum pa'o/ /tshogs bzhes tshar ba dang / de nas slob dpon gyis de kho na nyid kyi don la cung zad mnyam par bzhag sbyin bdag tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir/ thabs shes gnyis dang ldan pa'i chos zab mo bshad par gsungs pas/ de la slob dpon gyis dpal rdo rje gur las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i sa bon gyi thig le thos nas sems gsal ba bsgrub pa nye bar gyur nas tshig 'di dag gsungs pa/ sems dpa' med cing bsgom pa med/ /sngags med lha yang med pa ste/ /sems kyi rdo rje las byung ba/ /'di ni byang chub rim brtan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/

/zhes gsungs pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis kyang rgyud kyi tshig zab mo re gsung ba zhu/ zhes slob dpon gyis brjod/ sgrub grogs rnams kyis kyang gral rim bzhin rgyud tshig cung zad re brjod pa gsung gi 'khor lo ste cha bzhi pa'o/ /nang gi mkha' 'gro rnams glu gar gyis tshim pa ni/ dpon slob thams cad kyis 'di ltar brjod de/ e ma bde ba'i longs spyod 'di/ /e ma bde ba rab gsal nyid/ /phyag rgya chen po grub pa ni/ /rab tu 'phel ba'i rol gar 'di/ /zhes brjod pa sku'i 'khor lo ste cha lnga pa'o/ /cha drug pa lus dkyil gyi lha lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis tshim pa ni/ ye shes kyi rig pa la brten nas mchod pa yin pas/ rang phyi kyai rdo rje yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa dang / lus dkyil gyi pho brang lnga'i gtso bo rnams kyang snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi thugs rgyud la bde stong mchog gi ting nge 'dzin skyes par bsam pa ni thugs kyi 'khor lo ste dngos gzhi tshim pa drug go /de nas lhag ma ni/ bza' btung gi lhag ma rnams snod gcig tu bsdus la gtso bo'i drung du bzhag nas/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum byas te/ lhag ma'i gtor ma la byin rlabs gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / slob dpon gyis ma da na cung zad 'thung ste/ lag pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya byas pa'i nang nas kha phrus lhag ma la btab ste phaiṃ zhes brjod/ de nas chang gis cung zad bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ uts+tshiṭa ṭha ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod la se gol gtog lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams tshim par gyur cig ces dang / mtshan mo yin na dpal 'bar btsugs nas phyir dor ro/ /des phyi rol gyi 'byung po tshim par byas nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro bsdus te bkra shis par bya ba ni/ dril bsil dang rdo rje'i glu phun sum tshogs pa'i tshigs bcad gsum gyi bkra shis/

rigs su skye dang sogs kyi smon lam bya'o/ /de nas thod pa'i rdzas rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod dang / 'thor yab kyis bsang chu gtor la/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs rgyas pa ltar las/ khyad par ni rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thod pa'i rdzas rnams la thim pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thogs med du stsol ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrī'i sngags lan gsum tsam brjod pa bdud rtsi byin rlabs ltar byed/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis gzungs thag nas bzung la/ rang he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ lus gang bas sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams bsregs shing sbyangs/ slar hūm̐ las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga snying kha nas thon/ gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas 'od zer gyi rtse las mchod pa'i yo byad dpag med 'phros nas mdun bskyed dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha/ grub pa rig 'dzin gyi tshogs rnams la phul bas mnyes te tshogs rdzogs par bsam/ de dag gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od zer las bdud rtsi'i rgyun char chen po ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa kha dog 'ja' tshon lta bu bdud rtsi rnams la babs shing thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la gong 'og gi dmigs pa gnyis ka gsal gang thebs kyi ngang nas sgrub g.yog pa gnyis bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir/ sum+bha ni re mos kyis gsung mi chag tu bzla zhing / bdud rtsi byin rlabs dang gzungs thag 'dzin mi dgos/ gzhan dpon slob rnams kyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsung mi chag tu bzla 'o/ /thun gcod pa dang spyod lam gyi shugs kyis 'gro dgos byung na/
