steng gi rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas 'od du zhu nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ spyod lam grub nas slob dpon la phyag re phul stan la 'dug pa dang / sngar bzhin bdud rtsi byin rlabs dmigs pa sogs byed cing bzla/ de bzhin thun nam spod pa'i tshe snga mas zhu bar bsam/ phyi mas gsal btab cing bsgom la bzla/ dpon slob nyung zhing sman mang na zhag grangs kyang bco lnga nyi shu sogs sa ga tshang ma dgos na'ang grol ba'i dus ni zla ba de kha'i gnam gang gi snga thun la dgos so/ /rang ngam gnyis lta bus bsgrubs na tshogs 'khor mi thub pas/ de la dgos pa'i nyer spyod lnga 'bul ba mi dgos/ bstod pa nyi shu pa'i rjes la bdud rtsi lce thog myangs nas gnas gsum reg la 'bru gsum brjod pas lus dkyil tshim zhing sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ gzhan gang yang mi dgos/ rang gis bsang chu bsgrub/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ lam dus rgyas pa/ maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod sogs phal cher 'dra/ gsol ba'i dus zas kyi rnal 'byor rgyas pa'i dmigs pa gang gsal ma brjed pa byed/ zas lhag la mchil ma btab ste/ uts+tshiṣ+ṭas lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la byin/ tsha ba yan la thun gcig gtor bsngo bsdus pa rjes chog 'dra/ tsha ba grol nas sa srib bar la thun gcig ste gnyis ka la lam dus rgyas pa maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod dang bcas pa'i thun gnyis byed/ thun bzhi sogs chag med byed mkhan yin na srub gang bder byas chog sngags thun sum+bha ni brgya rtsa re bzlas nas 'bru gsum kho na bzla/ tshogs 'khor med na rdor glu sogs grub nas thun gtor 'bul/ de man 'dra/ byung na rang gcig pus bsgrub/ 'dam btags pa ril bu sgril ba la dbang thob pa rang blo khel cing 'dris pa lag len mkhas pa du dgos byas pa rang skal dus dang bstun pa legs pa myong bas grub legs/ de yang phye ma la zhag gsum/ lde gu la zhag gsum/

de lhag ril bu bsgril/ lde gu'i nyin dang / ril bu bsgril ba'i bar srod thun snga thun gyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa gnyis ma mdzad pa sku khams mi dub pa yong / ril bu bsgril tshar rim gyis thod par blug 'khor los kha bkab pa sogs sngar bzhin byed/ ril bu bsgril ring yang ngag mi gtong ba 'bru gsum dang sum+bha ni dal med bzla/ dpon slob gnyis gsum las med na srod la nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ gsung mi chag ma thub kyang skyon med de/ rje btsun rin po ches nyung na ci rigs bya gsungs pas skyon med par sems so/ /thun bsdud pa dang / steng gi rdo rje nyi ma sogs bstim nas/ rjes chog gi mchod pa byin rlabs nas bkra shis bar spyi dang 'dra/ thun bzhi'i byed lugs thor thun dang / dgong thun gnyis rgyas pa maṇ+ḍal mchod chog snga thun dang srod thun gnyis lam dus 'bring po/ de yang thor thun rjes su gtor bsngo bsdus pa bya/ rjes chog gi gong du bdud rtsi byin rlabs dmigs pa sogs gong bzhin byas nas/ gzungs thag dang sngags thun 'dzin/ skabs babs la snga ma rnams bzlas pa bsdus te tsha ba byed/ yang bdud rtsi byin rlabs sogs byas sngags thun sogs 'dzin/ phyi ma rnams tsha ba byed/ grol nas sngags thun sogs 'dzin/ de nas snga ma rnams kyis snga thun gyi gnas mchod byin rlabs thor thun gyi de la bsdus/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar lam dus 'bring po byas nas bdud rtsi rnams sngags thun 'dzin pa sogs gong bzhin bya/ de nas phyi ma rnams kyis snga thun sogs byed/ dgong thun dang srod thun yang des rigs 'gre/ 'on kyang dgong thun rjes la gtor bsngo rgyas pa bskang ba sogs gang byed thams cad byed pa tsam mo/ /dgong thun rjes la dro bzhes mdzad/ bza' btung rnams kyang re mos su byas la gsung mi chag byed/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor gyi dmigs pa gong tshogs 'khor gyis tshim pa cha gnyis kyi skabs ltar ma brjed par bya/

zas kyi lhag ma cung zad la mchil ma btab ste lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no/ /zhes phyir dor/ tshogs bar pa lde gu bsgrub pa'i thun dang po dang / tha ma ril bu bsgrub pa'i thun rting ma gnam gang gi thor thun la bya dgos pas dri ba dris lan sogs cho ga'i rnam gzhag tshang ma nyer gsum gyi dgong bzhin bya/ gnam gang gi snga dro sngags thun gyi mjug tu/ steng gi rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas dpon slob thams cad kyis rtsa sngags aṣ+ṭa dang / sum+bha ni brgya rtsa re bzlas/ de nas ril bu rnams kyi steng gi nam mkhar pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la skad cig gis mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam par bzhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun dpag tu med pa byung nas ril bu rnams la thim pas/ rdo rje tshe'i rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub stsol ba'i ngo bor gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ā yu puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ puṇ+ya puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes pa sngags tshan gnyis po lnga brgya tsam re bzlas shing dmigs pa gsal gang thebs byed/ bzla 'phro bsdud pa dang / steng gi tshe dpag med yab yum 'od du zhu nas ril bu rnams la thim pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thams cad 'dus par bsam/ de nas rjes chog dang bkra shis rgyas par bya/ gtor ma steng du 'bul bar spro na so so'i phyag len bzhin 'di'i skabs su gtang rag gi tshul du 'bul/ lam dus 'bring po 'di gnyis la maṇ+ḍal mchod chog dang / gtor bsngo ma byas kyang skyon med de/ rje btsun gyi thun spod pa'i tshe rang rang gi yan lag drug pa'i mngon rtogs tshang bar bsgoms nas bdud rtsi byin rlabs gsal btab cing bya gsungs pas so/ /sum+bha ni bzla mkhan gyis thun rgyas pa gnyis ma gtogs bsdus pa gnyis bya mi dgos/

gong gi sman brdung ba/ lde gu'i 'dam btags byed pa sogs kyi dus dmigs pa ni/ stan pa a las chos 'byung gi rang bzhin bha ga dang / gtun ril hūm̐ las rdo rjer bsam/ brdung mkhan rang nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje dang pad+ma srub par bsgom/ de'i sgra las oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang / sbyor mtshams nas bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi skya chil chil byung bar bsam pa'o/ /phye ma lde gur gtong tshe rdza thod sa bre re tsam 'gro ba dgu la chang yang la yang sing byas pa'i shin tu gar ba bdun shu re dgos/ des sman nyung rigs bsgres la shes par bya'o/ /grol ba'i snga dro thor thun rkyang pas chog cing tshogs 'khor tha ma mdzad/ srod thun spod mkhan gyis lam dus 'bring po byed/ thor thun tshang mas phyogs gcig mdzad/ ril bu che chung gi tshad ni che ba sran ma/ chung ba yungs 'bru tsam gsungs pas sman mang nyung dang bstun nas byed/ gzhan yang khri rdo/ stong rdo/ brgya rdo/ bcu rdo sogs dgos pa dang bstun nas gang dgos byed/ ril bu bsgril ba dang / 'dam btags byed dus lag pa shin tu gtsang bar bkru/ sen mo 'breg cing ji ltar rigs pa'i rdo la bdar nas/ sen srub kyi dreg pa cung zad kyang med pa sogs 'bags pa'i dri mas ma gos pa rang la gal che/ rang la nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir legs/ gnas khang gsar pa ma thul ba dang / gzhi bdag 'jig rten pa'i rigs mang ba rang nyid kyis shes shing rgyas par spro ba sogs byung na/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol ji ltar 'os pa'i phyogs bzhir tho brtan po brtsigs la/ rgyal chen gyi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i dar cog phru gu re btsugs/ de rnams kyi mdun du rim pa bzhin mchod gtor bshams la/ phur pa sogs gang 'dris kyi cho gas rgyal chen tho 'dzugs byed/ 'di yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dgongs pa yin pas grub na shin tu legs/

ma byas na'ang skyon med de/ sa lo sogs mdzad pa yang ma mthong zhing / rje btsun gyis ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gang ltar bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa 'di gsang ba dam pa rang legs/ 'on kyang rang nyid rtogs pa bzang por rloms pa dang / snyan grags 'dod pa dang / kheng dregs kyis ma gos shing / rnam rtog med na skyon med do/ /bsten pa'i grangs dang / phan yon sogs ni rje btsun rin po ches mdzad par shes so// //uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i srung 'khor 'bri tshul ni/ shog bu/ ras/ zangs sogs gzhi gang yang rung ba la lte bar mu khyud cig bskor/ de'i phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bris pa'i phyi rol tu mu khyud nyis rim/ de'i phyi rol rdo rwa me ris 'bar ba bri/ lte ba'i dbus su oṃ āḥhūm̐ bris pa'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu'i 'og tu phaṭ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / dam tshig gi rdzas la gnod par byed pa'i dgra 'dre lha srin sde brgyad kyi gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa gnyis/ de nas de wa pi tsu hūm̐/ am̐ sogs lha dgu'i sa bon rjes rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / dam tshig gi rdzas la gnod par byed pa'i dgra 'dre log par blta ba mi mthun pa'i phyogs 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa: zhes pa rnams yig mgo phyir bstan/ phaṭ nas brtsams te oṃ āḥhūm̐ la g.yas bskor gyis gzha' bskor tshul gyis rim pas bskor/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu'i 'og thad nas yig mgo phyir bstan gyis/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇahūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bi d+ya ra dza/ rnal 'byor pa sogs spel tshig gong bzhin gyi mjug tu bsam ngan sbyor rtsub rbad 'dre rbod gtong byad kha mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa: ku ru hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa g.yas bskor du bri/ de'i phyi rol gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar rtsibs/

dbus kyi hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu'i 'og thad la yig mgo phyir bstan gyi na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yoḥ na mo badz+ra mut+ga ra hastā ya tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la ā k+ṣe pa kā ra ya/ rnal 'byor pa sogs spel tshig lte ba bzhin la rak+ṣa ku ru hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa yig phreng gi tshul du 'khor lo rtsibs khengs pa 'bri/ de bzhin du g.yas bskor gyis rtsibs gnyis pa la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yoḥṭik+ka'i hūm̐ dzaḥrnal 'byor pa sogs spel tshig dang rak+ṣa ku ru hūm̐ phaṭ/ spel tshig dang rak+ṣa ku ru sogs rtsibs tshang ma la rigs 'gre/ rtsibs gsum pa la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yoḥ mahā daṇ+ḍa dha ra bi bi dha su ra a su ra marda na bhu tān+nirma tha/ rtsibs bzhi pa la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yoḥ oṃ ma ma daṇ+ḍa ya nī la/ ya nī la daṇ+ḍa la tu ru tu ru mu ru mu ru sarba duṣ+ṭan ma ra ya/ rtsibs lnga pa la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yoḥ hu lu hu lu mahā pad+ma a mṛ tī ku ru mahā bi ṣan āḥ rtsibs drug pa la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha bh+yoḥ na mo mahā ba lā ya uts+tshuṣ+yi kro dha rā dzā ya sarba nā gā nam̐ hri da ya tā ṭa ya/ rtsibs bdun pa la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yoḥ na mo badz+ra ro dhā ya mahā dam̐ṣ+ṭorka ra bhe ra wā ya badz+ra san+to ha dar+pā ya a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ rtsibs brgyad pa la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yoḥ na mo a tsa la/ kān tseṭ+ṭa tseṭ+ṭa moṭ+ṭa moṭ+ṭa tuṭ+ṭa tuṭ+ṭa gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / dam tshig gi rdzas la rak+ṣa ku ru hūm̐ phaṭ thams cad la 'gre/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la lte ba'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu'i thad nas yig mgo phyir bstan gyi g.yas bskor du/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nam̐ nas phaṭ gsum gyi bar uṣ+ṇi ṣa tshang ma dang / de'i rjes su rnal 'byor sogs spel tshig gi mthar mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa ku ru hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa bri/ mu khyud kyi sngags 'di rnams bar mtshams med pa khengs pa dang /

lte bar yang sngags spel tshig dang bcas pas khengs pa dgos so/ /ma khengs na rak+ṣa mang du 'jug go /mu khyud phyi ma la rdo rwa me ri rnams bris tshar ba dang / kha che la sogs pa dri bzang gis/ sngags dang rdo rwa me ris rnams byugs/ rab gnas ni thun mong gi srung 'khor nang du 'khor lo rnam snang du bskyed/ zhu ba las 'khor lor gyur pa'i nang du yig 'bru rnams 'od dpag med du bskyed nas zhal bsgyur te yi ge a li ka l̥'i rnam par gyur/ ces pa sogs gong 'og kun rab gnas spyi dang mthun no/ /yang uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i 'khor lo 'di mi la bsrung ba 'dogs na/ gzhan rab gnas sogs tshang ma khyad med la/ spel tshig rnal 'byor pa sogs kyi skabs su/ 'chang ba po la lha srin sde brgyad kyi gnod pa sogs rigs 'gre shes dgos/ de ltar dri bzang sogs byugs grub pa dang bltabs la tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram du dkris/ rab gnas gong bzhin byas/ srung skogs sogs bsrung ba spyi dang mthun no/ /'di lta bu'i 'chi med ril bu bsgrub tshul gsal bar bkod pa 'di ni/ dmigs med thugs rje'i mnga' bdag sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid dang / de'i sras kyi thu bo yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpal ldan bkra shis pa la sogs te yongs 'dzin du mas bka' drin bskyangs shing zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa chos med snyom las mkhan dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis rang bzo'i skyon spangs te/ rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi'i lo sa ga zla ba'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub pa brnyes pa'i dus chen thog bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa'i bar mtshams su rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i yig cha sor bzhag gi lugs dang / khyad par sa lo chen pos sgrub pa lan gnyis gnang ba'i phyag len mthong zhing / sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpal ldan bkra shis kyis sgrub pa mdzad pa'i phyag phyi lan gcig byas pa dang /

yongs 'dzin dam pa dkon mchog lhun grub pa la sgrub tshul gyi phyag len zhib tu gtugs pa sogs phyag len gsung bgros kyis kyang brgyan te dpal sa skya'i lha chen theg chen pho brang gi lam 'bras lha khang du sug bris bgyis pa 'di la nyes pa mchis na bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzad nas/ lam 'bras kyi bar chad zhi ba dang / rnal 'byor par rlom zhing nus pa med pa rang dang 'dra ba rnams dang / ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po spun sogs la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rtogs pa'i gdeng dang ldan zhing sha lnga sogs la dngos su sgrub pa mdzad pa dang / rgyas pa la spro ba rnams/ rje btsun rin po che dang / chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhal snga nas blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yig char zhib tu gzigs pa zhu/ 'di bris dge ba bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bdag sogs rim gnyis sgom pa'i rgyud dag la/ /ye shes dga' bzhi'i rgyud kyis legs gtams nas/ /mthar thug sku bzhi'i 'bras bu mngon gyur shog /ces pa de rnams kyis snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas// ༈ //spyi don bdun pa de lta bu'i bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rdzas kyi ril bu 'di la byin rlabs kyi rgyun bzhugs tshul bshad pa ni/ de ltar rang re dpal ldan sa skya pa'i phyag len 'khrul pa med pa'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i 'chi med dam rdzas ril bu 'di la byin rlabs kyi rgyun bzhugs tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ de yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs gnyis kyis rkang mgyogs kyi rdzu 'phrul thob pa'i slob ma rnams gtong bar mdzad nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ bla ma grub thob/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi sku sha

sku gdung / rak+ta/ byang sems sogs byin rlabs kyi rigs tshang ma bsdus pa rnams/ sngon 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya thub pas stag mo la sku lus sbyin par btang ba'i spur rus bzhugs pa'i sa sbags te/ rgyal ba nyid kyis sgyu rtsal 'gran pa'i skabs phyag mda' 'phangs pa'i dus/ sa 'og nas chu brdol ba'i mda' chu khron par grags pa'i chus sbrus te 'jim pa'i ril bu mang po mdzad pa/ kha che paṇa chen gyi phyag tu 'jim ril du ma zhig byung ba la/ slar yang paṇa chen nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rten mang du bsre bar mdzad pa la/ thog mar yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gdung / grub chen sa ra ha dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub sogs nas/ kha che paṇa chen gyi bar du byon pa'i rgya gar gyi mkhas grub phal che ba'i gdung rus dang / gzhan yang 'phags yul rdo rje gdan/ bya rgod phung po'i ri bo/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ yul chen nyer bzhi/ gnas chen so gnyis kyi sa rnams bsres pa la/ rgya gar gyi yul gru tha dad na bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs rten gyi rigs tshang ma bsdud par mdzad cing / de'i steng du bod kyi mkhas grub skyes chen dam pa/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po/ rje khri srong lde'u btsan/ lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun sogs nas rje btsun rin po che yan chad kyi gdung rus sogs byin rlabs rten ma tshang ba med pa lhan cig tu sbags te 'dam du mdzad pa'i phyag len chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa la rten 'dam dpe grags ma zhes ming du 'dogs par mdzad pa dang / sngar gyi byin rlabs kyi rgyun de rnams kyi steng du/ slar yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos byin rlabs kyi rten bsdu bar mdzad pa la/ chos rje sa paṇa dang 'phags pa rin po che nas bzung / sa lo chen po'i bar gyi sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa rim par byon pa rnams kyi sku gdung / shangs mtshal/ gdung thal/ spur tsha sogs/

gzhan yang byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ dbon ston skyer khang pa/ rje tshogs bsgom pa/ rje nyan chen pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub rnams kyi gdung rus/ gdung thal/ zhun/ spur tsha rnams dang / gzhan yang rje rdo rje 'chang gi rten 'brel rdzas kyi ril bu/ dam pa sangs rgyas kyi skye bdun/ ma cig re ma'i sku sha rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsang ba'i bdud rtsi/ khyad par theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku sha shin tu stobs che ba bsre bar mdzad cing / gzhan yang lhag par du yang med thabs med pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dam rdzas ril bu rang gi byin rlabs kyi gta'i rgyun bzhugs pa la/ rgya gar gyi grub chen rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bdud rtsi ril bu dang / bod kyi skyes chen rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ rje na bza' brag phug pa bsod nams dpal ba/ rgyal ba gnyis pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ zhwa lu mkhyen rab chos rje/ mus chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang rnams kyi dam rdzas ril bu'i rgyun dang / khyad par bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rgya gar gyi mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa dang /

gangs ri'i khrod kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nyid slar yang bsam bzhin du byon pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa nyid kyi dam rdzas ril bu'i rgyun stobs che bar bzhugs shing / gzhan yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po dang / sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi sku gdung dang / rje mus chen nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rten mang po phyogs gcig du bsdud par mdzad pa'i ril bu dang / 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gis khams kyi 'dam mdog na bzhugs pa'i sa skya pa'i byin rlabs khungs thub thams cad bsdud par mdzad pa'i lha 'dam sogs/ mdor na byin rlabs kyi rgyun bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams bla ma gong ma na rim bzhin gyis bum chu'i rgyun bzhugs pa'i chu dang lhan cig tu gsar du bsgrubs pa'i sman gyi phye ma rnams dang sbags te bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i dam rdzas 'chi med ril bu 'di ni/ gsang sngags kyi lam du zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams la med thabs med pa'i rdzas mchog dam pa yin par lta smos kyang ci dgos/ skal bzang las 'phro can su zhig gi khar song yang myong grol gyi rdzas bla na med pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis de lta bu'i bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rdzas kyi ril bu 'di la byin rlabs kyi rgyun bzhugs tshul bshad pa bstan zin nas/ de dag gis ni dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sngags 'chang rnams la med thabs med pa'i dus rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub tshul gyi gsung rab rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa nyon mongs nad kun sel ba'i sman mchog bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ma lus pa bstan zin to// //de ltar dam rdzas ril bu bsgrub tshul gyi/ /tshad ldan gong ma'i gsung rab kun 'dus pa'i/

/nyon mongs nad sel sman mchog bdud rtsi yi/ /rgya mtsho che 'di sbyar ba las byung ba'i/ /dge ba gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar des/ /bdag dang gdul bya rjes 'jug slob mar bcas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don rnams/ /'bad med 'grub ste spyi dang bye brag gi /bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar rab rgyas shing / /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /rgyal ba kun gyis bsngags pa'i zhing gi mchog /bde ba can zhes grags pa der skyes nas/ /'od dpag med mgon mngon sum mthong bar shog /de yi nus pas sa lam myur bgrod nas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod cing khams gsum gyi/ /'gro kun dag pa'i zhing der 'dren gyur cig /ces dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sngags 'chang rnams la med thabs med pa'i dus rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub tshul gyi gsung rab rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa nyon mongs nad kun sel ba'i sman mchog bdud rtsi'i rgyal mtsho zhes bya ba 'di yang / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa chen po rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / dkyil 'khor kun gyi rigs bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal ba mus pa chen po rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs sen rin po che dbang gi rgyal po spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod pa'i sa skya pa chos med snyoms las mkhan za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang lo bcu phrag gsum lon pa me pho stag gi lo sa ga zla ba'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub pa brnyes pa'i dus bzang gi tshe/ dpal sa skya'i lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang du dam rdzas ril bu chig sgrub byas pa'i rjes de ma thag par rigs dang chos kyi bu la sogs pa rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i slob ma'i tshogs rnams dang /

bstan pa'i rgyun la phan du re nas sbyar ba 'di la bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzad nas bstan 'gro la phan pa dang bde ba'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'di'i yi ge pa ni gdan sa dan khrod pa bsam 'grub kyis mgyogs par bgyis so/ /smras pa/ dam rdzas bsgrub 'dod don gnyer rnams/ /bsgrub tshul bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /bltas na rang dang gzhan gyi don/ /bde blag nyid du 'grub par 'gyur/ /ka l+yā na war+dhan+tu// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 48 a myes zhabs/ bdud rtsi'i ril bu sgrub tshul gyi gsung rab rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 47
